## Create a Session

<a id="opIdPostFinancialConnectionsSessions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/financial_connections/sessions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'account_holder=%7B%22account%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22customer%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22customer_account%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22account%22%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&filters=%7B%22account_subcategories%22%3A%5B%22checking%22%5D%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22require_payment_method_support%22%3A%22all%22%7D&limits=%7B%22accounts%22%3A0%7D&manual_entry=%7B%22mode%22%3A%22automatic%22%7D&permissions=%5B%22balances%22%5D&prefetch=%5B%22balances%22%5D&return_url=string'
```

`POST /v1/financial_connections/sessions`

<p>To launch the Financial Connections authorization flow, create a <code>Session</code>. The session’s <code>client_secret</code> can be used to launch the flow using Stripe.js.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
account_holder:
  account: string
  customer: string
  customer_account: string
  type: account
expand:
  - string
filters:
  account_subcategories:
    - checking
  country: string
  require_payment_method_support: all
limits:
  accounts: 0
manual_entry:
  mode: automatic
permissions:
  - balances
prefetch:
  - balances
return_url: string
```

<h3 id="create-a-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» account_holder|body|object|true|The account holder to link accounts for.|
|» » account|body|string|false|none|
|» » customer|body|string|false|none|
|» » customer_account|body|string|false|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» filters|body|object|false|Filters to restrict the kinds of accounts to collect.|
|» » account_subcategories|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » country|body|string|false|none|
|» » require_payment_method_support|body|string|false|none|
|» limits|body|object|false|Settings for configuring Session-specific limits.|
|» » accounts|body|integer \| string|true|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» manual_entry|body|object|false|Customize manual entry behavior|
|» » mode|body|string|false|none|
|» permissions|body|[string]|true|List of data features that you would like to request access to.<br><br>Possible values are `balances`, `transactions`, `ownership`, and `payment_method`.|
|» prefetch|body|[string]|false|List of data features that you would like to retrieve upon account creation.|

  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&payment_method=string&replacements=%5B%22card_cvc%22%5D&request=%7B%22body%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22headers%22%3A%5B%7B%22name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22value%22%3A%22string%22%7D%5D%7D&url=string'

replacements:

    -
      name: string

This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. |» » » name|body|string|true|none|
|» » » value|body|string|true|none|

  -d 'client_reference_id=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&options=%7B%22document%22%3A%7B%22allowed_types%22%3A%5B%22driving_license%22%5D%2C%22require_id_number%22%3Atrue%2C%22require_live_capture%22%3Atrue%2C%22require_matching_selfie%22%3Atrue%7D%7D&provided_details=%7B%22email%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22phone%22%3A%22string%22%7D&related_customer=string&related_customer_account=string&related_person=%7B%22account%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22person%22%3A%22string%22%7D&return_url=string&type=document&verification_flow=string'
```

`POST /v1/identity/verification_sessions`

<p>Creates a VerificationSession object.</p>

<p>After the VerificationSession is created, display a verification modal using the session <code>client_secret</code> or send your users to the session’s <code>url</code>.</p>

<p>If your API key is in test mode, verification checks won’t actually process, though everything else will occur as if in live mode.</p>

<p>Related guide: <a href="/docs/identity/verify-identity-documents">Verify your users’ identity documents</a></p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
client_reference_id: string
expand:
  - string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
options:
  document:
    allowed_types:
      - driving_license
    require_id_number: true
    require_live_capture: true
    require_matching_selfie: true
provided_details:
  email: string
  phone: string
related_customer: string
related_customer_account: string
related_person:
  account: string
  person: string
return_url: string
type: document
verification_flow: string
```

## Redact a VerificationSession

<a id="opIdPostIdentityVerificationSessionsSessionRedact"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/identity/verification_sessions/string/redact \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D'
```

`POST /v1/identity/verification_sessions/{session}/redact`

<p>Redact a VerificationSession to remove all collected information from Stripe. This will redact
the VerificationSession and all objects related to it, including VerificationReports, Events,
request logs, etc.</p>

<p>A VerificationSession object can be redacted when it is in <code>requires_input</code> or <code>verified</code>
<a href="/docs/identity/how-sessions-work">status</a>. Redacting a VerificationSession in <code>requires_action</code>
state will automatically cancel it.</p>

<p>The redaction process may take up to four days. When the redaction process is in progress, the
VerificationSession’s <code>redaction.status</code> field will be set to <code>processing</code>; when the process is
finished, it will change to <code>redacted</code> and an <code>identity.verification_session.redacted</code> event
will be emitted.</p>

<p>Redaction is irreversible. Redacted objects are still accessible in the Stripe API, but all the
fields that contain personal data will be replaced by the string <code>[redacted]</code> or a similar
placeholder. The <code>metadata</code> field will also be erased. Redacted objects cannot be updated or
used for any purpose.</p>

<p><a href="/docs/identity/verification-sessions#redact">Learn more</a>.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
```

<h3 id="redact-a-verificationsession-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|session|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|

`GET /v1/invoice_payments`

For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|

`POST /v1/invoice_rendering_templates/{template}/archive`

<p>Updates the status of an invoice rendering template to ‘archived’ so no new Stripe objects (customers, invoices, etc.) can reference it. The template can also no longer be updated. However, if the template is already set on a Stripe object, it will continue to be applied on invoices generated by it.</p>

```yaml
expand:

## List all invoice items

<a id="opIdGetInvoiceitems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoiceitems \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/invoiceitems`

<p>Returns a list of your invoice items. Invoice items are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recently created invoice items appearing first.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="list-all-invoice-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created|query|object \| integer|false|Only return invoice items that were created during the given date interval.|
|customer|query|string|false|The identifier of the customer whose invoice items to return. If none is provided, returns all invoice items.|
|customer_account|query|string|false|The identifier of the account representing the customer whose invoice items to return. If none is provided, returns all invoice items.|
|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|invoice|query|string|false|Only return invoice items belonging to this invoice. If none is provided, all invoice items will be returned. If specifying an invoice, no customer identifier is needed.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|pending|query|boolean|false|Set to `true` to only show pending invoice items, which are not yet attached to any invoices. Set to `false` to only show invoice items already attached to invoices. If unspecified, no filter is applied.|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

## Create an invoice item

<a id="opIdPostInvoiceitems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoiceitems \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount=0&currency=string&customer=string&customer_account=string&description=string&discountable=true&discounts=%5B%7B%22coupon%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22discount%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22promotion_code%22%3A%22string%22%7D%5D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&invoice=string&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&period=%7B%22end%22%3A0%2C%22start%22%3A0%7D&price_data=%7B%22currency%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_behavior%22%3A%22exclusive%22%2C%22unit_amount%22%3A0%2C%22unit_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D&pricing=%7B%22price%22%3A%22string%22%7D&quantity=0&quantity_decimal=string&subscription=string&tax_behavior=exclusive&tax_code=string&tax_rates=%5B%22string%22%5D&unit_amount_decimal=string'
```

`POST /v1/invoiceitems`

<p>Creates an item to be added to a draft invoice (up to 250 items per invoice). If no invoice is specified, the item will be on the next invoice created for the customer specified.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount: 0
currency: string
customer: string
customer_account: string
description: string
discountable: true
discounts:
  -
    coupon: string
    discount: string
    promotion_code: string
expand:
  - string
invoice: string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
period:
  end: 0
  start: 0
price_data:
  currency: string
  product: string
  tax_behavior: exclusive
  unit_amount: 0
  unit_amount_decimal: string
pricing:
  price: string
quantity: 0
quantity_decimal: string
subscription: string
tax_behavior: exclusive
tax_code: string
tax_rates:
  - string
unit_amount_decimal: string
```

`POST /v1/invoiceitems/{invoiceitem}`

## List all invoices

<a id="opIdGetInvoices"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/invoices`

<p>You can list all invoices, or list the invoices for a specific customer. The invoices are returned sorted by creation date, with the most recently created invoices appearing first.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="list-all-invoices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|collection_method|query|string|false|The collection method of the invoice to retrieve. Either `charge_automatically` or `send_invoice`.|
|created|query|object \| integer|false|Only return invoices that were created during the given date interval.|
|customer|query|string|false|Only return invoices for the customer specified by this customer ID.|
|customer_account|query|string|false|Only return invoices for the account representing the customer specified by this account ID.|
|due_date|query|object \| integer|false|none|
|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|
|status|query|string|false|The status of the invoice, one of `draft`, `open`, `paid`, `uncollectible`, or `void`. [Learn more](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/invoices/workflow#workflow-overview)|
|subscription|query|string|false|Only return invoices for the subscription specified by this subscription ID.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|collection_method|charge_automatically|
|collection_method|send_invoice|
|status|draft|
|status|open|
|status|paid|
|status|uncollectible|
|status|void|

`POST /v1/invoices/create_preview`

<p>At any time, you can preview the upcoming invoice for a subscription or subscription schedule. This will show you all the charges that are pending, including subscription renewal charges, invoice item charges, etc. It will also show you any discounts that are applicable to the invoice.</p>

<p>You can also preview the effects of creating or updating a subscription or subscription schedule, including a preview of any prorations that will take place. To ensure that the actual proration is calculated exactly the same as the previewed proration, you should pass the <code>subscription_details.proration_date</code> parameter when doing the actual subscription update.</p>

<p>The recommended way to get only the prorations being previewed on the invoice is to consider line items where <code>parent.subscription_item_details.proration</code> is <code>true</code>.</p>

<p>Note that when you are viewing an upcoming invoice, you are simply viewing a preview – the invoice has not yet been created. As such, the upcoming invoice will not show up in invoice listing calls, and you cannot use the API to pay or edit the invoice. If you want to change the amount that your customer will be billed, you can add, remove, or update pending invoice items, or update the customer’s discount.</p>

<p>Note: Currency conversion calculations use the latest exchange rates. Exchange rates may vary between the time of the preview and the time of the actual invoice creation. <a href="https://docs.stripe.com/currencies/conversions">Learn more</a></p>

<h3 id="create-a-preview-invoice-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response.|[invoice](#schemainvoice)|
|default|Default|Error response.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, bearerAuth
</aside>

## Search invoices

<a id="opIdGetInvoicesSearch"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/search?query=string' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/invoices/search`

<p>Search for invoices you’ve previously created using Stripe’s <a href="/docs/search#search-query-language">Search Query Language</a>.
Don’t use search in read-after-write flows where strict consistency is necessary. Under normal operating
conditions, data is searchable in less than a minute. Occasionally, propagation of new or updated data can be up
to an hour behind during outages. Search functionality is not available to merchants in India.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="search-invoices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|page|query|string|false|A cursor for pagination across multiple pages of results. Don't include this parameter on the first call. Use the next_page value returned in a previous response to request subsequent results.|
|query|query|string|true|The search query string. See [search query language](https://docs.stripe.com/search#search-query-language) and the list of supported [query fields for invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/search#query-fields-for-invoices).|
|body|body|object|false|none|

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}`

<p>Draft invoices are fully editable. Once an invoice is <a href="/docs/billing/invoices/workflow#finalized">finalized</a>,
you can no longer change most of its details, including monetary values and <code>collection_method</code>. For most invoices,
this also includes <code>description</code>.</p>

<p>If you would like to stop the Stripe Billing engine from automatically finalizing, reattempting payments on,
sending reminders for, or <a href="/docs/billing/invoices/reconciliation">automatically reconciling</a> invoices, pass
<code>auto_advance=false</code>.</p>

## Delete a draft invoice

<a id="opIdDeleteInvoicesInvoice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`DELETE /v1/invoices/{invoice}`

<p>Permanently deletes a one-off invoice draft. This cannot be undone. Attempts to delete invoices that are no longer in a draft state will fail; once an invoice has been finalized or if an invoice is for a subscription, it must be <a href="/api/invoices/void">voided</a>.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="delete-a-draft-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "deleted": true,
  "id": "string",
  "object": "invoice"
}
```

## Bulk add invoice line items

<a id="opIdPostInvoicesInvoiceAddLines"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/add_lines \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&invoice_metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&lines=%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22discountable%22%3Atrue%2C%22discounts%22%3A%5B%7B%22coupon%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22discount%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22promotion_code%22%3A%22string%22%7D%5D%2C%22invoice_item%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22metadata%22%3A%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22period%22%3A%7B%22end%22%3A0%2C%22start%22%3A0%7D%2C%22price_data%22%3A%7B%22currency%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_data%22%3A%7B%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22images%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22metadata%22%3A%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_details%22%3A%7B%22performance_location%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_code%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22unit_label%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22tax_behavior%22%3A%22exclusive%22%2C%22unit_amount%22%3A0%2C%22unit_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22pricing%22%3A%7B%22price%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22quantity%22%3A0%2C%22quantity_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_amounts%22%3A%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22tax_rate_data%22%3A%7B%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22display_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22inclusive%22%3Atrue%2C%22jurisdiction%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22jurisdiction_level%22%3A%22city%22%2C%22percentage%22%3A0%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_type%22%3A%22amusement_tax%22%7D%2C%22taxability_reason%22%3A%22customer_exempt%22%2C%22taxable_amount%22%3A0%7D%5D%2C%22tax_rates%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%7D%5D'
```

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/add_lines`

<p>Adds multiple line items to an invoice. This is only possible when an invoice is still a draft.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
invoice_metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
lines:
  -
    amount: 0
    description: string
    discountable: true
    discounts:
      -
        coupon: string
        discount: string
        promotion_code: string
    invoice_item: string
    metadata:
      property1: string
      property2: string
    period:
      end: 0
      start: 0
    price_data:
      currency: string
      product: string
      product_data:
        description: string
        images:
          - string
        metadata:
          property1: string
          property2: string
        name: string
        tax_code: string
        tax_details:
          performance_location: string
          tax_code: string
        unit_label: string
      tax_behavior: exclusive
      unit_amount: 0
      unit_amount_decimal: string
    pricing:
      price: string
    quantity: 0
    quantity_decimal: string
    tax_amounts:
      -
        amount: 0
        tax_rate_data:
          country: string
          description: string
          display_name: string
          inclusive: true
          jurisdiction: string
          jurisdiction_level: city
          percentage: 0
          state: string
          tax_type: amusement_tax
        taxability_reason: customer_exempt
        taxable_amount: 0
    tax_rates:
      - string
```

## Attach a payment to an Invoice

<a id="opIdPostInvoicesInvoiceAttachPayment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/attach_payment \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&payment_intent=string&payment_record=string'
```

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/attach_payment`

<p>Attaches a PaymentIntent or an Out of Band Payment to the invoice, adding it to the list of <code>payments</code>.</p>

<p>For the PaymentIntent, when the PaymentIntent’s status changes to <code>succeeded</code>, the payment is credited
to the invoice, increasing its <code>amount_paid</code>. When the invoice is fully paid, the
invoice’s status becomes <code>paid</code>.</p>

<p>If the PaymentIntent’s status is already <code>succeeded</code> when it’s attached, it’s
credited to the invoice immediately.</p>

<p>See: <a href="/docs/invoicing/partial-payments">Partial payments</a> to learn more.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
payment_intent: string
payment_record: string
```

<h3 id="attach-a-payment-to-an-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» payment_intent|body|string|false|The ID of the PaymentIntent to attach to the invoice.|
|» payment_record|body|string|false|The ID of the PaymentRecord to attach to the invoice.|

## Finalize an invoice

<a id="opIdPostInvoicesInvoiceFinalize"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/finalize \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'auto_advance=true&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D'
```

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/finalize`

<p>Stripe automatically finalizes drafts before sending and attempting payment on invoices. However, if you’d like to finalize a draft invoice manually, you can do so using this method.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
auto_advance: true
expand:
  - string
```

<h3 id="finalize-an-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» auto_advance|body|boolean|false|Controls whether Stripe performs [automatic collection](https://docs.stripe.com/invoicing/integration/automatic-advancement-collection) of the invoice. If `false`, the invoice's state doesn't automatically advance without an explicit action.|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|

`GET /v1/invoices/{invoice}/lines`

<p>When retrieving an invoice, you’ll get a <strong>lines</strong> property containing the total count of line items and the first handful of those items. There is also a URL where you can retrieve the full (paginated) list of line items.</p>

## Update an invoice's line item

<a id="opIdPostInvoicesInvoiceLinesLineItemId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/lines/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount=0&description=string&discountable=true&discounts=%5B%7B%22coupon%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22discount%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22promotion_code%22%3A%22string%22%7D%5D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&period=%7B%22end%22%3A0%2C%22start%22%3A0%7D&price_data=%7B%22currency%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_data%22%3A%7B%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22images%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22metadata%22%3A%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_details%22%3A%7B%22performance_location%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_code%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22unit_label%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22tax_behavior%22%3A%22exclusive%22%2C%22unit_amount%22%3A0%2C%22unit_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D&pricing=%7B%22price%22%3A%22string%22%7D&quantity=0&quantity_decimal=string&tax_amounts=%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22tax_rate_data%22%3A%7B%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22display_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22inclusive%22%3Atrue%2C%22jurisdiction%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22jurisdiction_level%22%3A%22city%22%2C%22percentage%22%3A0%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_type%22%3A%22amusement_tax%22%7D%2C%22taxability_reason%22%3A%22customer_exempt%22%2C%22taxable_amount%22%3A0%7D%5D&tax_rates=%5B%22string%22%5D'
```

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/lines/{line_item_id}`

<p>Updates an invoice’s line item. Some fields, such as <code>tax_amounts</code>, only live on the invoice line item,
so they can only be updated through this endpoint. Other fields, such as <code>amount</code>, live on both the invoice
item and the invoice line item, so updates on this endpoint will propagate to the invoice item as well.
Updating an invoice’s line item is only possible before the invoice is finalized.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount: 0
description: string
discountable: true
discounts:
  -
    coupon: string
    discount: string
    promotion_code: string
expand:
  - string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
period:
  end: 0
  start: 0
price_data:
  currency: string
  product: string
  product_data:
    description: string
    images:
      - string
    metadata:
      property1: string
      property2: string
    name: string
    tax_code: string
    tax_details:
      performance_location: string
      tax_code: string
    unit_label: string
  tax_behavior: exclusive
  unit_amount: 0
  unit_amount_decimal: string
pricing:
  price: string
quantity: 0
quantity_decimal: string
tax_amounts:
  -
    amount: 0
    tax_rate_data:
      country: string
      description: string
      display_name: string
      inclusive: true
      jurisdiction: string
      jurisdiction_level: city
      percentage: 0
      state: string
      tax_type: amusement_tax
    taxability_reason: customer_exempt
    taxable_amount: 0
tax_rates:
  - string
```

## Mark an invoice as uncollectible

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/mark_uncollectible \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/mark_uncollectible`

<p>Marking an invoice as uncollectible is useful for keeping track of bad debts that can be written off for accounting purposes.</p>

## Pay an invoice

<a id="opIdPostInvoicesInvoicePay"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/pay \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&forgive=true&mandate=string&off_session=true&paid_out_of_band=true&payment_method=string&source=string'
```

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/pay`

<p>Stripe automatically creates and then attempts to collect payment on invoices for customers on subscriptions according to your <a href="https://dashboard.stripe.com/account/billing/automatic">subscriptions settings</a>. However, if you’d like to attempt payment on an invoice out of the normal collection schedule or for some other reason, you can do so.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
forgive: true
mandate: string
off_session: true
paid_out_of_band: true
payment_method: string
source: string
```

<h3 id="pay-an-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» forgive|body|boolean|false|In cases where the source used to pay the invoice has insufficient funds, passing `forgive=true` controls whether a charge should be attempted for the full amount available on the source, up to the amount to fully pay the invoice. This effectively forgives the difference between the amount available on the source and the amount due. <br><br>Passing `forgive=false` will fail the charge if the source hasn't been pre-funded with the right amount. An example for this case is with ACH Credit Transfers and wires: if the amount wired is less than the amount due by a small amount, you might want to forgive the difference. Defaults to `false`.|
|» mandate|body|string|false|ID of the mandate to be used for this invoice. It must correspond to the payment method used to pay the invoice, including the payment_method param or the invoice's default_payment_method or default_source, if set.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» off_session|body|boolean|false|Indicates if a customer is on or off-session while an invoice payment is attempted. Defaults to `true` (off-session).|
|» paid_out_of_band|body|boolean|false|Boolean representing whether an invoice is paid outside of Stripe. This will result in no charge being made. Defaults to `false`.|
|» payment_method|body|string|false|A PaymentMethod to be charged. The PaymentMethod must be the ID of a PaymentMethod belonging to the customer associated with the invoice being paid.|
|» source|body|string|false|A payment source to be charged. The source must be the ID of a source belonging to the customer associated with the invoice being paid.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » *anyOf*|""|

## Bulk remove invoice line items

<a id="opIdPostInvoicesInvoiceRemoveLines"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/remove_lines \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&invoice_metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&lines=%5B%7B%22behavior%22%3A%22delete%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22string%22%7D%5D'
```

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/remove_lines`

<p>Removes multiple line items from an invoice. This is only possible when an invoice is still a draft.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
invoice_metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
lines:
  -
    behavior: delete
    id: string
```

<h3 id="bulk-remove-invoice-line-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» invoice_metadata|body|object \| string|false|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» lines|body|[object]|true|The line items to remove.|
|» » behavior|body|string|true|none|
|» » id|body|string|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » *anyOf*|""|
|» » behavior|delete|
|» » behavior|unassign|

## Send an invoice for manual payment

<a id="opIdPostInvoicesInvoiceSend"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/send \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D'
```

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/send`

<p>Stripe will automatically send invoices to customers according to your <a href="https://dashboard.stripe.com/account/billing/automatic">subscriptions settings</a>. However, if you’d like to manually send an invoice to your customer out of the normal schedule, you can do so. When sending invoices that have already been paid, there will be no reference to the payment in the email.</p>

<p>Requests made in test-mode result in no emails being sent, despite sending an <code>invoice.sent</code> event.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
```

<h3 id="send-an-invoice-for-manual-payment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|

## Bulk update invoice line items

<a id="opIdPostInvoicesInvoiceUpdateLines"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/update_lines \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&invoice_metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&lines=%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22discountable%22%3Atrue%2C%22discounts%22%3A%5B%7B%22coupon%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22discount%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22promotion_code%22%3A%22string%22%7D%5D%2C%22id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22metadata%22%3A%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22period%22%3A%7B%22end%22%3A0%2C%22start%22%3A0%7D%2C%22price_data%22%3A%7B%22currency%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_data%22%3A%7B%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22images%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22metadata%22%3A%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_details%22%3A%7B%22performance_location%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_code%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22unit_label%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22tax_behavior%22%3A%22exclusive%22%2C%22unit_amount%22%3A0%2C%22unit_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22pricing%22%3A%7B%22price%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22quantity%22%3A0%2C%22quantity_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_amounts%22%3A%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22tax_rate_data%22%3A%7B%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22display_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22inclusive%22%3Atrue%2C%22jurisdiction%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22jurisdiction_level%22%3A%22city%22%2C%22percentage%22%3A0%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22tax_type%22%3A%22amusement_tax%22%7D%2C%22taxability_reason%22%3A%22customer_exempt%22%2C%22taxable_amount%22%3A0%7D%5D%2C%22tax_rates%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%7D%5D'
```

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/update_lines`

<p>Updates multiple line items on an invoice. This is only possible when an invoice is still a draft.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
invoice_metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
lines:
  -
    amount: 0
    description: string
    discountable: true
    discounts:
      -
        coupon: string
        discount: string
        promotion_code: string
    id: string
    metadata:
      property1: string
      property2: string
    period:
      end: 0
      start: 0
    price_data:
      currency: string
      product: string
      product_data:
        description: string
        images:
          - string
        metadata:
          property1: string
          property2: string
        name: string
        tax_code: string
        tax_details:
          performance_location: string
          tax_code: string
        unit_label: string
      tax_behavior: exclusive
      unit_amount: 0
      unit_amount_decimal: string
    pricing:
      price: string
    quantity: 0
    quantity_decimal: string
    tax_amounts:
      -
        amount: 0
        tax_rate_data:
          country: string
          description: string
          display_name: string
          inclusive: true
          jurisdiction: string
          jurisdiction_level: city
          percentage: 0
          state: string
          tax_type: amusement_tax

## Void an invoice

<a id="opIdPostInvoicesInvoiceVoid"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/string/void \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D'
```

`POST /v1/invoices/{invoice}/void`

<p>Mark a finalized invoice as void. This cannot be undone. Voiding an invoice is similar to <a href="/api/invoices/delete">deletion</a>, however it only applies to finalized invoices and maintains a papertrail where the invoice can still be found.</p>

<p>Consult with local regulations to determine whether and how an invoice might be amended, canceled, or voided in the jurisdiction you’re doing business in. You might need to <a href="/api/invoices/create">issue another invoice</a> or <a href="/api/credit_notes/create">credit note</a> instead. Stripe recommends that you consult with your legal counsel for advice specific to your business.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
```

<h3 id="void-an-invoice-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invoice|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|

## List all authorizations

<a id="opIdGetIssuingAuthorizations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/authorizations \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/issuing/authorizations`

<p>Returns a list of Issuing <code>Authorization</code> objects. The objects are sorted in descending order by creation date, with the most recently created object appearing first.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="list-all-authorizations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|card|query|string|false|Only return authorizations that belong to the given card.|
|cardholder|query|string|false|Only return authorizations that belong to the given cardholder.|
|created|query|object \| integer|false|Only return authorizations that were created during the given date interval.|
|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|
|status|query|string|false|Only return authorizations with the given status. One of `pending`, `closed`, or `reversed`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|status|closed|
|status|expired|
|status|pending|
|status|reversed|

## Update an authorization

<a id="opIdPostIssuingAuthorizationsAuthorization"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/authorizations/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D'
```

`POST /v1/issuing/authorizations/{authorization}`

<p>Updates the specified Issuing <code>Authorization</code> object by setting the values of the parameters passed. Any parameters not provided will be left unchanged.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
```

<h3 id="update-an-authorization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|authorization|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» metadata|body|object \| string|false|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » *anyOf*|""|

## Approve an authorization

<a id="opIdPostIssuingAuthorizationsAuthorizationApprove"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/authorizations/string/approve \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount=0&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D'
```

`POST /v1/issuing/authorizations/{authorization}/approve`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

<p>[Deprecated] Approves a pending Issuing <code>Authorization</code> object. This request should be made within the timeout window of the <a href="/docs/issuing/controls/real-time-authorizations">real-time authorization</a> flow. 
This method is deprecated. Instead, <a href="/docs/issuing/controls/real-time-authorizations#authorization-handling">respond directly to the webhook request to approve an authorization</a>.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount: 0
expand:
  - string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
```

<h3 id="approve-an-authorization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|authorization|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» amount|body|integer|false|If the authorization's `pending_request.is_amount_controllable` property is `true`, you may provide this value to control how much to hold for the authorization. Must be positive (use [`decline`](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/authorizations/decline) to decline an authorization request).|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|

This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|

## Decline an authorization

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/authorizations/string/decline \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D'
```

`POST /v1/issuing/authorizations/{authorization}/decline`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated

This method is deprecated. Instead, <a href="/docs/issuing/controls/real-time-authorizations#authorization-handling">respond directly to the webhook request to decline an authorization</a>.</p>

metadata:

## List all cardholders

<a id="opIdGetIssuingCardholders"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/cardholders \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/issuing/cardholders`

<p>Returns a list of Issuing <code>Cardholder</code> objects. The objects are sorted in descending order by creation date, with the most recently created object appearing first.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="list-all-cardholders-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created|query|object \| integer|false|Only return cardholders that were created during the given date interval.|
|email|query|string|false|Only return cardholders that have the given email address.|
|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|phone_number|query|string|false|Only return cardholders that have the given phone number.|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|
|status|query|string|false|Only return cardholders that have the given status. One of `active`, `inactive`, or `blocked`.|
|type|query|string|false|Only return cardholders that have the given type. One of `individual` or `company`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

|status|active|

## Create a cardholder

<a id="opIdPostIssuingCardholders"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/cardholders \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'billing=%7B%22address%22%3A%7B%22city%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line2%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22postal_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%7D%7D&company=%7B%22tax_id%22%3A%22string%22%7D&email=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&individual=%7B%22card_issuing%22%3A%7B%22user_terms_acceptance%22%3A%7B%22date%22%3A0%2C%22ip%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22user_agent%22%3A%22string%22%7D%7D%2C%22dob%22%3A%7B%22day%22%3A0%2C%22month%22%3A0%2C%22year%22%3A0%7D%2C%22first_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22last_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22verification%22%3A%7B%22document%22%3A%7B%22back%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22front%22%3A%22string%22%7D%7D%7D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&name=string&phone_number=string&preferred_locales=%5B%22de%22%5D&spending_controls=%7B%22allowed_card_presences%22%3A%5B%22not_present%22%5D%2C%22allowed_categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22allowed_merchant_countries%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22blocked_card_presences%22%3A%5B%22not_present%22%5D%2C%22blocked_categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22blocked_merchant_countries%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22spending_limits%22%3A%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22interval%22%3A%22all_time%22%7D%5D%2C%22spending_limits_currency%22%3A%22string%22%7D&status=active&type=company'
```

`POST /v1/issuing/cardholders`

<p>Creates a new Issuing <code>Cardholder</code> object that can be issued cards.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
billing:
  address:
    city: string
    country: string
    line1: string
    line2: string
    postal_code: string
    state: string
company:
  tax_id: string
email: string
expand:
  - string
individual:
  card_issuing:
    user_terms_acceptance:
      date: 0
      ip: string
      user_agent: string
  dob:
    day: 0
    month: 0
    year: 0
  first_name: string
  last_name: string
  verification:
    document:
      back: string
      front: string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
name: string
phone_number: string
preferred_locales:
  - de
spending_controls:
  allowed_card_presences:
    - not_present
  allowed_categories:
    - ac_refrigeration_repair
  allowed_merchant_countries:
    - string
  blocked_card_presences:
    - not_present
  blocked_categories:
    - ac_refrigeration_repair
  blocked_merchant_countries:
    - string
  spending_limits:
    -
      amount: 0
      categories:
        - ac_refrigeration_repair
      interval: all_time
  spending_limits_currency: string
status: active
type: company
```

## Update a cardholder

<a id="opIdPostIssuingCardholdersCardholder"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/cardholders/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'billing=%7B%22address%22%3A%7B%22city%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line2%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22postal_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%7D%7D&company=%7B%22tax_id%22%3A%22string%22%7D&email=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&individual=%7B%22card_issuing%22%3A%7B%22user_terms_acceptance%22%3A%7B%22date%22%3A0%2C%22ip%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22user_agent%22%3A%22string%22%7D%7D%2C%22dob%22%3A%7B%22day%22%3A0%2C%22month%22%3A0%2C%22year%22%3A0%7D%2C%22first_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22last_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22verification%22%3A%7B%22document%22%3A%7B%22back%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22front%22%3A%22string%22%7D%7D%7D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&phone_number=string&preferred_locales=%5B%22de%22%5D&spending_controls=%7B%22allowed_card_presences%22%3A%5B%22not_present%22%5D%2C%22allowed_categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22allowed_merchant_countries%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22blocked_card_presences%22%3A%5B%22not_present%22%5D%2C%22blocked_categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22blocked_merchant_countries%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22spending_limits%22%3A%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22interval%22%3A%22all_time%22%7D%5D%2C%22spending_limits_currency%22%3A%22string%22%7D&status=active'
```

`POST /v1/issuing/cardholders/{cardholder}`

<p>Updates the specified Issuing <code>Cardholder</code> object by setting the values of the parameters passed. Any parameters not provided will be left unchanged.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
billing:
  address:
    city: string
    country: string
    line1: string
    line2: string
    postal_code: string
    state: string
company:
  tax_id: string
email: string
expand:
  - string
individual:
  card_issuing:
    user_terms_acceptance:
      date: 0
      ip: string
      user_agent: string
  dob:
    day: 0
    month: 0
    year: 0
  first_name: string
  last_name: string
  verification:
    document:
      back: string
      front: string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
phone_number: string
preferred_locales:
  - de
spending_controls:
  allowed_card_presences:
    - not_present
  allowed_categories:
    - ac_refrigeration_repair
  allowed_merchant_countries:
    - string
  blocked_card_presences:
    - not_present
  blocked_categories:
    - ac_refrigeration_repair
  blocked_merchant_countries:
    - string
  spending_limits:
    -
      amount: 0
      categories:
        - ac_refrigeration_repair
      interval: all_time
  spending_limits_currency: string
status: active
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response.|[issuing.cardholder](#schemaissuing.cardholder)|
|default|Default|Error response.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, bearerAuth
</aside>

## List all cards

<a id="opIdGetIssuingCards"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/cards \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/issuing/cards`

<p>Returns a list of Issuing <code>Card</code> objects. The objects are sorted in descending order by creation date, with the most recently created object appearing first.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="list-all-cards-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|cardholder|query|string|false|Only return cards belonging to the Cardholder with the provided ID.|
|created|query|object \| integer|false|Only return cards that were issued during the given date interval.|
|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|exp_month|query|integer|false|Only return cards that have the given expiration month.|
|exp_year|query|integer|false|Only return cards that have the given expiration year.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|last4|query|string|false|Only return cards that have the given last four digits.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|personalization_design|query|string|false|none|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|
|status|query|string|false|Only return cards that have the given status. One of `active`, `inactive`, or `canceled`.|
|type|query|string|false|Only return cards that have the given type. One of `virtual` or `physical`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|active|
|status|canceled|
|status|inactive|
|type|physical|
|type|virtual|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response.|Inline|
|default|Default|Error response.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<h3 id="list-all-cards-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[[issuing.card](#schemaissuing.card)]|true|none|none|
|has_more|boolean|true|none|True if this list has another page of items after this one that can be fetched.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Always has the value `list`.|
|url|string|true|none|The URL where this list can be accessed.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|object|list|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, bearerAuth
</aside>

## Create a card

<a id="opIdPostIssuingCards"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/cards \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'cardholder=string&currency=string&exp_month=0&exp_year=0&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&financial_account=string&lifecycle_controls=%7B%22cancel_after%22%3A%7B%22payment_count%22%3A0%7D%7D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&personalization_design=string&pin=%7B%22encrypted_number%22%3A%22string%22%7D&replacement_for=string&replacement_reason=damaged&second_line=string&shipping=%7B%22address%22%3A%7B%22city%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line2%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22postal_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22address_validation%22%3A%7B%22mode%22%3A%22disabled%22%7D%2C%22business_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22customs%22%3A%7B%22eori_number%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22phone_number%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22require_signature%22%3Atrue%2C%22service%22%3A%22express%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22bulk%22%7D&spending_controls=%7B%22allowed_card_presences%22%3A%5B%22not_present%22%5D%2C%22allowed_categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22allowed_merchant_countries%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22blocked_card_presences%22%3A%5B%22not_present%22%5D%2C%22blocked_categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22blocked_merchant_countries%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22spending_limits%22%3A%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22interval%22%3A%22all_time%22%7D%5D%7D&status=active&type=physical'
```

`POST /v1/issuing/cards`

<p>Creates an Issuing <code>Card</code> object.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
cardholder: string
currency: string
exp_month: 0
exp_year: 0
expand:
  - string
financial_account: string
lifecycle_controls:
  cancel_after:
    payment_count: 0
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
personalization_design: string
pin:
  encrypted_number: string
replacement_for: string
replacement_reason: damaged
second_line: string
shipping:
  address:
    city: string
    country: string
    line1: string
    line2: string
    postal_code: string
    state: string
  address_validation:
    mode: disabled
  business_name: string
  customs:
    eori_number: string
  name: string
  phone_number: string
  require_signature: true
  service: express
  type: bulk
spending_controls:
  allowed_card_presences:
    - not_present
  allowed_categories:
    - ac_refrigeration_repair
  allowed_merchant_countries:
    - string
  blocked_card_presences:
    - not_present
  blocked_categories:
    - ac_refrigeration_repair
  blocked_merchant_countries:
    - string
  spending_limits:
    -
      amount: 0
      categories:
        - ac_refrigeration_repair
      interval: all_time
status: active
type: physical
```

  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"

## Update a card

<a id="opIdPostIssuingCardsCard"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/cards/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'cancellation_reason=lost&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&personalization_design=string&pin=%7B%22encrypted_number%22%3A%22string%22%7D&shipping=%7B%22address%22%3A%7B%22city%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line2%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22postal_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22address_validation%22%3A%7B%22mode%22%3A%22disabled%22%7D%2C%22business_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22customs%22%3A%7B%22eori_number%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22phone_number%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22require_signature%22%3Atrue%2C%22service%22%3A%22express%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22bulk%22%7D&spending_controls=%7B%22allowed_card_presences%22%3A%5B%22not_present%22%5D%2C%22allowed_categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22allowed_merchant_countries%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22blocked_card_presences%22%3A%5B%22not_present%22%5D%2C%22blocked_categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22blocked_merchant_countries%22%3A%5B%22string%22%5D%2C%22spending_limits%22%3A%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22categories%22%3A%5B%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%5D%2C%22interval%22%3A%22all_time%22%7D%5D%7D&status=active'
```

`POST /v1/issuing/cards/{card}`

<p>Updates the specified Issuing <code>Card</code> object by setting the values of the parameters passed. Any parameters not provided will be left unchanged.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
cancellation_reason: lost
expand:
  - string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
personalization_design: string
pin:
  encrypted_number: string
shipping:
  address:
    city: string
    country: string
    line1: string
    line2: string
    postal_code: string
    state: string
  address_validation:
    mode: disabled
  business_name: string
  customs:
    eori_number: string
  name: string
  phone_number: string
  require_signature: true
  service: express
  type: bulk
spending_controls:
  allowed_card_presences:
    - not_present
  allowed_categories:
    - ac_refrigeration_repair
  allowed_merchant_countries:
    - string
  blocked_card_presences:
    - not_present
  blocked_categories:
    - ac_refrigeration_repair
  blocked_merchant_countries:
    - string
  spending_limits:
    -
      amount: 0
      categories:
        - ac_refrigeration_repair
      interval: all_time
status: active
```

## List all disputes

<a id="opIdGetIssuingDisputes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/disputes \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/issuing/disputes`

<p>Returns a list of Issuing <code>Dispute</code> objects. The objects are sorted in descending order by creation date, with the most recently created object appearing first.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="list-all-disputes-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created|query|object \| integer|false|Only return Issuing disputes that were created during the given date interval.|
|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|
|status|query|string|false|Select Issuing disputes with the given status.|
|transaction|query|string|false|Select the Issuing dispute for the given transaction.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|expired|
|status|lost|
|status|submitted|
|status|unsubmitted|
|status|won|

## Create a dispute

<a id="opIdPostIssuingDisputes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/disputes \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount=0&evidence=%7B%22canceled%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22canceled_at%22%3A0%2C%22cancellation_policy_provided%22%3Atrue%2C%22cancellation_reason%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22expected_at%22%3A0%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_type%22%3A%22%22%2C%22return_status%22%3A%22%22%2C%22returned_at%22%3A0%7D%2C%22duplicate%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22card_statement%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22cash_receipt%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22check_image%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22original_transaction%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22fraudulent%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22merchandise_not_as_described%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22received_at%22%3A0%2C%22return_description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22return_status%22%3A%22%22%2C%22returned_at%22%3A0%7D%2C%22no_valid_authorization%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22not_received%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22expected_at%22%3A0%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_type%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22other%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_type%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22reason%22%3A%22canceled%22%2C%22service_not_as_described%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22canceled_at%22%3A0%2C%22cancellation_reason%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22received_at%22%3A0%7D%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&transaction=string&treasury=%7B%22received_debit%22%3A%22string%22%7D'
```

`POST /v1/issuing/disputes`

<p>Creates an Issuing <code>Dispute</code> object. Individual pieces of evidence within the <code>evidence</code> object are optional at this point. Stripe only validates that required evidence is present during submission. Refer to <a href="/docs/issuing/purchases/disputes#dispute-reasons-and-evidence">Dispute reasons and evidence</a> for more details about evidence requirements.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount: 0
evidence:
  canceled:
    additional_documentation: string
    canceled_at: 0
    cancellation_policy_provided: true
    cancellation_reason: string
    expected_at: 0
    explanation: string
    product_description: string
    product_type: ""
    return_status: ""
    returned_at: 0
  duplicate:
    additional_documentation: string
    card_statement: string
    cash_receipt: string
    check_image: string
    explanation: string
    original_transaction: string
  fraudulent:
    additional_documentation: string
    explanation: string
  merchandise_not_as_described:
    additional_documentation: string
    explanation: string
    received_at: 0
    return_description: string
    return_status: ""
    returned_at: 0
  no_valid_authorization:
    additional_documentation: string
    explanation: string
  not_received:
    additional_documentation: string
    expected_at: 0
    explanation: string
    product_description: string
    product_type: ""
  other:
    additional_documentation: string
    explanation: string
    product_description: string
    product_type: ""
  reason: canceled
  service_not_as_described:
    additional_documentation: string
    canceled_at: 0
    cancellation_reason: string
    explanation: string
    received_at: 0
expand:
  - string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
transaction: string
treasury:
  received_debit: string
```

  -X POST \

  -d 'amount=0&evidence=%7B%22canceled%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22canceled_at%22%3A0%2C%22cancellation_policy_provided%22%3Atrue%2C%22cancellation_reason%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22expected_at%22%3A0%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_type%22%3A%22%22%2C%22return_status%22%3A%22%22%2C%22returned_at%22%3A0%7D%2C%22duplicate%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22card_statement%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22cash_receipt%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22check_image%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22original_transaction%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22fraudulent%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22merchandise_not_as_described%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22received_at%22%3A0%2C%22return_description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22return_status%22%3A%22%22%2C%22returned_at%22%3A0%7D%2C%22no_valid_authorization%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22not_received%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22expected_at%22%3A0%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_type%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22other%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22product_type%22%3A%22%22%7D%2C%22reason%22%3A%22canceled%22%2C%22service_not_as_described%22%3A%7B%22additional_documentation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22canceled_at%22%3A0%2C%22cancellation_reason%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22explanation%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22received_at%22%3A0%7D%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D'

`POST /v1/issuing/disputes/{dispute}`

<p>Updates the specified Issuing <code>Dispute</code> object by setting the values of the parameters passed. Any parameters not provided will be left unchanged. Properties on the <code>evidence</code> object can be unset by passing in an empty string.</p>

## Submit a dispute

<a id="opIdPostIssuingDisputesDisputeSubmit"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/disputes/string/submit \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D'
```

`POST /v1/issuing/disputes/{dispute}/submit`

<p>Submits an Issuing <code>Dispute</code> to the card network. Stripe validates that all evidence fields required for the dispute’s reason are present. For more details, see <a href="/docs/issuing/purchases/disputes#dispute-reasons-and-evidence">Dispute reasons and evidence</a>.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|dispute|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» metadata|body|object \| string|false|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|

## List all personalization designs

<a id="opIdGetIssuingPersonalizationDesigns"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/personalization_designs \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/issuing/personalization_designs`

<p>Returns a list of personalization design objects. The objects are sorted in descending order by creation date, with the most recently created object appearing first.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="list-all-personalization-designs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|lookup_keys|query|[string]|false|Only return personalization designs with the given lookup keys.|
|preferences|query|object|false|Only return personalization designs with the given preferences.|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|
|status|query|string|false|Only return personalization designs with the given status.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

## Create a personalization design

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/issuing/personalization_designs \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'card_logo=string&carrier_text=%7B%22footer_body%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22footer_title%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22header_body%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22header_title%22%3A%22string%22%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&lookup_key=string&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&name=string&physical_bundle=string&preferences=%7B%22is_default%22%3Atrue%7D&transfer_lookup_key=true'

## Create a Session

<a id="opIdPostLinkAccountSessions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/link_account_sessions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'account_holder=%7B%22account%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22customer%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22customer_account%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22account%22%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&filters=%7B%22account_subcategories%22%3A%5B%22checking%22%5D%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22require_payment_method_support%22%3A%22all%22%7D&limits=%7B%22accounts%22%3A0%7D&manual_entry=%7B%22mode%22%3A%22automatic%22%7D&permissions=%5B%22balances%22%5D&prefetch=%5B%22balances%22%5D&return_url=string'
```

`POST /v1/link_account_sessions`

<p>To launch the Financial Connections authorization flow, create a <code>Session</code>. The session’s <code>client_secret</code> can be used to launch the flow using Stripe.js.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
account_holder:
  account: string
  customer: string
  customer_account: string
  type: account
expand:
  - string
filters:
  account_subcategories:
    - checking
  country: string
  require_payment_method_support: all
limits:
  accounts: 0
manual_entry:
  mode: automatic
permissions:
  - balances
prefetch:
  - balances
return_url: string
```

<h3 id="create-a-session-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» account_holder|body|object|true|The account holder to link accounts for.|
|» » account|body|string|false|none|
|» » customer|body|string|false|none|
|» » customer_account|body|string|false|none|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» filters|body|object|false|Filters to restrict the kinds of accounts to collect.|
|» » account_subcategories|body|[string]|false|none|
|» » country|body|string|false|none|
|» » require_payment_method_support|body|string|false|none|
|» limits|body|object|false|Settings for configuring Session-specific limits.|
|» » accounts|body|integer \| string|true|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|integer|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» manual_entry|body|object|false|Customize manual entry behavior|
|» » mode|body|string|false|none|
|» permissions|body|[string]|true|List of data features that you would like to request access to.<br><br>Possible values are `balances`, `transactions`, `ownership`, and `payment_method`.|
|» prefetch|body|[string]|false|List of data features that you would like to retrieve upon account creation.|
|» return_url|body|string|false|For webview integrations only. Upon completing OAuth login in the native browser, the user will be redirected to this URL to return to your app.|

|---|---|

|» » account_subcategories|savings|
|» » require_payment_method_support|all|

## List Accounts
