`POST /v1/subscriptions/{subscription_exposed_id}`

<p>Updates an existing subscription to match the specified parameters.
When changing prices or quantities, we optionally prorate the price we charge next month to make up for any price changes.
To preview how the proration is calculated, use the <a href="/docs/api/invoices/create_preview">create preview</a> endpoint.</p>

<p>By default, we prorate subscription changes. For example, if a customer signs up on May 1 for a <currency>100</currency> price, they’ll be billed <currency>100</currency> immediately. If on May 15 they switch to a <currency>200</currency> price, then on June 1 they’ll be billed <currency>250</currency> (<currency>200</currency> for a renewal of her subscription, plus a <currency>50</currency> prorating adjustment for half of the previous month’s <currency>100</currency> difference). Similarly, a downgrade generates a credit that is applied to the next invoice. We also prorate when you make quantity changes. You can also <a href="/billing/scripts/stripe-authored/proration">use scripts to prorate your billing</a>. To learn more, see <a href="/billing/subscriptions/prorations">Prorations</a>.</p>

<p>Switching prices does not normally change the billing date or generate an immediate charge unless:</p>

<ul>
<li>The billing interval is changed (for example, from monthly to yearly).</li>
<li>The subscription moves from free to paid.</li>
<li>A trial starts or ends.</li>
</ul>

<p>In these cases, we apply a credit for the unused time on the previous price, immediately charge the customer using the new price, and reset the billing date. Learn about how <a href="/docs/billing/subscriptions/upgrade-downgrade#immediate-payment">Stripe immediately attempts payment for subscription changes</a>.</p>

<p>If you want to charge for an upgrade immediately, pass <code>proration_behavior</code> as <code>always_invoice</code> to create prorations, automatically invoice the customer for those proration adjustments, and attempt to collect payment. If you pass <code>create_prorations</code>, the prorations are created but not automatically invoiced. If you want to bill the customer for the prorations before the subscription’s renewal date, you need to manually <a href="/docs/api/invoices/create">invoice the customer</a>.</p>

<p>If you don’t want to prorate, set the <code>proration_behavior</code> option to <code>none</code>. With this option, the customer is billed <currency>100</currency> on May 1 and <currency>200</currency> on June 1. Similarly, if you set <code>proration_behavior</code> to <code>none</code> when switching between different billing intervals (for example, from monthly to yearly), we don’t generate any credits for the old subscription’s unused time. We still reset the billing date and bill immediately for the new subscription.</p>

<p>Updating the quantity on a subscription many times in an hour may result in <a href="/docs/rate-limits">rate limiting</a>. If you need to bill for a frequently changing quantity, consider integrating <a href="/docs/billing/subscriptions/usage-based">usage-based billing</a> instead.</p>

## Cancel a subscription

<a id="opIdDeleteSubscriptionsSubscriptionExposedId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'cancellation_details=%7B%22comment%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22feedback%22%3A%22%22%2C%22feedback_option%22%3A%22string%22%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&invoice_now=true&prorate=true'
```

`DELETE /v1/subscriptions/{subscription_exposed_id}`

<p>Cancels a customer’s subscription immediately. The customer won’t be charged again for the subscription. After it’s canceled, the subscription is largely immutable. You can still update its <a href="/metadata">metadata</a> and <code>cancellation_details</code>.</p>

<p>Any pending invoice items that you’ve created are still charged at the end of the period, unless manually <a href="/api/invoiceitems/delete">deleted</a>. If you’ve set the subscription to cancel at the end of the period, any pending prorations are also left in place and collected at the end of the period. But if the subscription is set to cancel immediately, pending prorations are removed if <code>invoice_now</code> and <code>prorate</code> are both set to false.</p>

<p>By default, upon subscription cancellation, Stripe stops automatic collection of all finalized invoices for the customer. This is intended to prevent unexpected payment attempts after the customer has canceled a subscription. However, you can resume automatic collection of the invoices manually after subscription cancellation to have us proceed. Or, you could check for unpaid invoices before allowing the customer to cancel the subscription at all.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
cancellation_details:
  comment: string
  feedback: ""
  feedback_option: string
expand:
  - string
invoice_now: true
prorate: true
```

<h3 id="cancel-a-subscription-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscription_exposed_id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» cancellation_details|body|object|false|Details about why this subscription was cancelled|
|» » comment|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » feedback|body|string|false|none|
|» » feedback_option|body|string|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» invoice_now|body|boolean|false|Will generate a final invoice that invoices for any un-invoiced metered usage and new/pending proration invoice items. Defaults to `false`.|
|» prorate|body|boolean|false|Will generate a proration invoice item that credits remaining unused time until the subscription period end. Defaults to `false`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » » *anyOf*|""|
|» » feedback|""|
|» » feedback|customer_service|
|» » feedback|low_quality|
|» » feedback|missing_features|
|» » feedback|other|
|» » feedback|switched_service|
|» » feedback|too_complex|
|» » feedback|too_expensive|
|» » feedback|unused|

## Pause a subscription

<a id="opIdPostSubscriptionsSubscriptionPause"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/string/pause \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'bill_for=%7B%22outstanding_usage_through%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22none%22%7D%2C%22unused_time_from%22%3A%7B%22type%22%3A%22item_current_period_start%22%7D%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&invoicing_behavior=invoice&type=subscription'
```

`POST /v1/subscriptions/{subscription}/pause`

<p>Pauses a subscription by transitioning it to the paused status. A paused subscription does not generate invoices and will not advance to new billing periods. The subscription can be resumed later using the resume endpoint. Cannot pause subscriptions with attached schedules.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
bill_for:
  outstanding_usage_through:
    type: none
  unused_time_from:
    type: item_current_period_start
expand:
  - string
invoicing_behavior: invoice
type: subscription
```

<h3 id="pause-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscription|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» bill_for|body|object|false|Controls what to bill for when pausing the subscription.|
|» » outstanding_usage_through|body|object|false|none|
|» » » type|body|string|true|none|
|» » unused_time_from|body|object|false|none|
|» » » type|body|string|true|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» invoicing_behavior|body|string|false|Determines how to handle debits and credits when pausing. Defaults to `pending_invoice_item`.|
|» type|body|string|false|The type of pause to apply. Defaults to `subscription`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » » type|none|
|» » » type|now|
|» » » type|item_current_period_start|
|» » » type|none|
|» » » type|now|
|» invoicing_behavior|invoice|
|» invoicing_behavior|pending_invoice_item|
|» type|subscription|

## Resume a subscription

<a id="opIdPostSubscriptionsSubscriptionResume"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/subscriptions/string/resume \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'billing_cycle_anchor=%7B%22type%22%3A%22now%22%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&payment_behavior=resume_on_payment_attempt&proration_behavior=always_invoice&proration_date=0'
```

`POST /v1/subscriptions/{subscription}/resume`

<p>Initiates resumption of a paused subscription, optionally resetting the billing cycle anchor and creating prorations. Resume is only available for subscriptions that use <code>charge_automatically</code> collection. If Stripe doesn’t generate a resumption invoice, the subscription becomes <code>active</code> immediately. When a resumption invoice is generated, Stripe finalizes it immediately. If the invoice is paid or marked uncollectible, the subscription becomes <code>active</code>. If the invoice is manually voided, the subscription stays <code>paused</code>. If there is no payment attempt within 23 hours, Stripe voids the invoice and the subscription stays <code>paused</code>. Learn more about <a href="/docs/billing/subscriptions/pause#resume-subscriptions">resuming subscriptions</a>.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
billing_cycle_anchor:
  type: now
expand:
  - string
payment_behavior: resume_on_payment_attempt
proration_behavior: always_invoice
proration_date: 0
```

<h3 id="resume-a-subscription-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|subscription|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» billing_cycle_anchor|body|object|false|The billing cycle anchor that applies when the subscription is resumed. Either `now` or `unchanged`. The default is `now`. For more information, see the billing cycle [documentation](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/billing-cycle).|
|» » type|body|string|true|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» payment_behavior|body|string|false|Controls whether Stripe attempts payment on the resumption invoice in the resume request, and how payment on that invoice affects the subscription's status. The default is `resume_on_payment_attempt`.|
|» proration_behavior|body|string|false|Determines how to handle [prorations](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/prorations) resulting from the `billing_cycle_anchor` being `unchanged`. When the `billing_cycle_anchor` is set to `now` (default value), no prorations are generated. If no value is passed, the default is `create_prorations`.|
|» proration_date|body|integer(unix-time)|false|If set, prorations will be calculated as though the subscription was resumed at the given time. This can be used to apply exactly the same prorations that were previewed with the [create preview](https://stripe.com/docs/api/invoices/create_preview) endpoint.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|now|
|» » type|unchanged|
|» payment_behavior|resume_on_payment_attempt|
|» payment_behavior|resume_on_payment_success|
|» proration_behavior|always_invoice|
|» proration_behavior|create_prorations|
|» proration_behavior|none|

`POST /v1/tax/calculations`

<p>Calculates tax based on the input and returns a Tax <code>Calculation</code> object.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
currency: string
customer: string
customer_details:
  address:
    city: string
    country: string
    line1: string
    line2: string
    postal_code: string
    state: string
  address_source: billing
  ip_address: string
  tax_ids:
    -
      type: ad_nrt
      value: string
  taxability_override: customer_exempt
expand:
  - string
line_items:
  -
    amount: 0
    metadata:
      property1: string
      property2: string
    performance_location: string
    product: string
    quantity: 0
    reference: string
    tax_behavior: exclusive
    tax_code: string
ship_from_details:
  address:
    city: string
    country: string
    line1: string
    line2: string
    postal_code: string
    state: string
shipping_cost:
  amount: 0
  shipping_rate: string
  tax_behavior: exclusive
  tax_code: string
tax_date: 0
```

## List tax locations

<a id="opIdGetTaxLocations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.stripe.com/v1/tax/locations?type=performance' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/tax/locations`

<p>Retrieve a list of all tax locations. Tax locations can represent the venues for services, tickets, or other product types.</p>

<p>The response includes detailed information for each tax location, such as its address, type, and description.</p>

<p>You can paginate through the list by using the <code>limit</code> parameter to control the number of results returned in each request.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="list-tax-locations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|
|type|query|string|true|Type of the tax location. Currently the only option is `performance`.|
|body|body|object|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|performance|

## Create a tax location

<a id="opIdPostTaxLocations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/tax/locations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'address=%7B%22city%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line2%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22postal_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%7D&description=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&type=performance'
```

`POST /v1/tax/locations`

<p>Create a tax location to use in calculating taxes for a service, ticket, or other type of product. The resulting object contains the ID, address, type, and description of the tax location.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
address:
  city: string
  country: string
  line1: string
  line2: string
  postal_code: string
  state: string
description: string
expand:
  - string
type: performance
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|

|» » city|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » country|body|string|true|none|

|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » state|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|Details to identify the tax location by its venue, types of events held, or available services, such as "A spacious auditorium suitable for large concerts and events.".|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|

<h3 id="list-registrations-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response.|Inline|
|default|Default|Error response.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<h3 id="list-registrations-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[[tax.registration](#schematax.registration)]|true|none|none|
|has_more|boolean|true|none|True if this list has another page of items after this one that can be fetched.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Always has the value `list`.|
|url|string|true|none|The URL where this list can be accessed.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|object|list|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, bearerAuth
</aside>

## Update a registration

<a id="opIdPostTaxRegistrationsId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/tax/registrations/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'active_from=now&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&expires_at=now'
```

`POST /v1/tax/registrations/{id}`

<p>Updates an existing Tax <code>Registration</code> object.</p>

<p>A registration cannot be deleted after it has been created. If you wish to end a registration you may do so by setting <code>expires_at</code>.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
active_from: now
expand:
  - string
expires_at: now
```

<h3 id="update-a-registration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» active_from|body|string \| integer(unix-time)|false|Time at which the registration becomes active. It can be either `now` to indicate the current time, or a timestamp measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer(unix-time)|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» expires_at|body|string \| integer(unix-time)|false|If set, the registration stops being active at this time. If not set, the registration will be active indefinitely. It can be either `now` to indicate the current time, or a timestamp measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|integer(unix-time)|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » *anyOf*|now|
|» » *anyOf*|now|
|» » *anyOf*|""|

`POST /v1/tax/settings`

<p>Updates Tax <code>Settings</code> parameters used in tax calculations. All parameters are editable but none can be removed once set. Check the returned Tax <code>Settings</code> object and validate that its status is <code>active</code>.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
defaults:
  tax_behavior: exclusive
  tax_code: string
expand:
  - string
head_office:
  address:

    country: string
    line1: string
    line2: string
    postal_code: string
    state: string
```

## Create a Transaction from a Calculation

<a id="opIdPostTaxTransactionsCreateFromCalculation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/tax/transactions/create_from_calculation \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'calculation=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&posted_at=0&reference=string'
```

`POST /v1/tax/transactions/create_from_calculation`

<p>Creates a Tax Transaction from a calculation, if that calculation hasn’t expired. Calculations expire after 90 days.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
calculation: string
expand:
  - string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
posted_at: 0
reference: string
```

<h3 id="create-a-transaction-from-a-calculation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» calculation|body|string|true|Tax Calculation ID to be used as input when creating the transaction.|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» metadata|body|object|false|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» posted_at|body|integer(unix-time)|false|The Unix timestamp representing when the tax liability is assumed or reduced, which determines the liability posting period and handling in tax liability reports. The timestamp must fall within the `tax_date` and the current time, unless the `tax_date` is scheduled in advance. Defaults to the current time.|
|» reference|body|string|true|A custom order or sale identifier, such as 'myOrder_123'. Must be unique across all transactions, including reversals.|

## Create a reversal Transaction

<a id="opIdPostTaxTransactionsCreateReversal"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/tax/transactions/create_reversal \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&flat_amount=0&line_items=%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22amount_tax%22%3A0%2C%22metadata%22%3A%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22original_line_item%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A0%2C%22reference%22%3A%22string%22%7D%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&mode=full&original_transaction=string&reference=string&shipping_cost=%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22amount_tax%22%3A0%7D'
```

`POST /v1/tax/transactions/create_reversal`

<p>Partially or fully reverses a previously created <code>Transaction</code>.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
flat_amount: 0
line_items:
  -
    amount: 0
    amount_tax: 0
    metadata:
      property1: string
      property2: string
    original_line_item: string
    quantity: 0
    reference: string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
mode: full
original_transaction: string
reference: string
shipping_cost:
  amount: 0
  amount_tax: 0
```

<h3 id="create-a-reversal-transaction-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» flat_amount|body|integer|false|A flat amount to reverse across the entire transaction, in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#minor-units) in negative. This value represents the total amount to refund from the transaction, including taxes.|
|» line_items|body|[object]|false|The line item amounts to reverse.|
|» » amount|body|integer|true|none|
|» » amount_tax|body|integer|true|none|
|» » metadata|body|object|false|none|
|» » » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » original_line_item|body|string|true|none|
|» » quantity|body|integer|false|none|
|» » reference|body|string|true|none|
|» metadata|body|object|false|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» mode|body|string|true|If `partial`, the provided line item or shipping cost amounts are reversed. If `full`, the original transaction is fully reversed.|
|» original_transaction|body|string|true|The ID of the Transaction to partially or fully reverse.|
|» reference|body|string|true|A custom identifier for this reversal, such as `myOrder_123-refund_1`, which must be unique across all transactions. The reference helps identify this reversal transaction in exported [tax reports](https://docs.stripe.com/tax/reports).|
|» shipping_cost|body|object|false|The shipping cost to reverse.|
|» » amount|body|integer|true|none|
|» » amount_tax|body|integer|true|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» mode|full|
|» mode|partial|

`GET /v1/tax_rates`

|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|inclusive|query|boolean|false|Optional flag to filter by tax rates that are inclusive (or those that are not inclusive).|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|

## Create a tax rate

<a id="opIdPostTaxRates"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/tax_rates \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'active=true&country=string&description=string&display_name=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&inclusive=true&jurisdiction=string&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&percentage=0&state=string&tax_type=amusement_tax'
```

`POST /v1/tax_rates`

<p>Creates a new tax rate.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
active: true
country: string
description: string
display_name: string
expand:
  - string
inclusive: true
jurisdiction: string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
percentage: 0
state: string
tax_type: amusement_tax
```

<h3 id="create-a-tax-rate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» active|body|boolean|false|Flag determining whether the tax rate is active or inactive (archived). Inactive tax rates cannot be used with new applications or Checkout Sessions, but will still work for subscriptions and invoices that already have it set.|
|» country|body|string|false|Two-letter country code ([ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)).|
|» description|body|string|false|An arbitrary string attached to the tax rate for your internal use only. It will not be visible to your customers.|
|» display_name|body|string|true|The display name of the tax rate, which will be shown to users.|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» inclusive|body|boolean|true|This specifies if the tax rate is inclusive or exclusive.|
|» jurisdiction|body|string|false|The jurisdiction for the tax rate. You can use this label field for tax reporting purposes. It also appears on your customer’s invoice.|
|» metadata|body|object|false|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» percentage|body|number|true|This represents the tax rate percent out of 100.|
|» state|body|string|false|[ISO 3166-2 subdivision code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2), without country prefix. For example, "NY" for New York, United States.|
|» tax_type|body|string|false|The high-level tax type, such as `vat` or `sales_tax`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» tax_type|amusement_tax|
|» tax_type|communications_tax|

|» tax_type|igst|
|» tax_type|jct|
|» tax_type|lease_tax|
|» tax_type|mass_transit_parking_tax|
|» tax_type|parking_tax|
|» tax_type|pst|
|» tax_type|qst|
|» tax_type|retail_delivery_fee|
|» tax_type|rst|
|» tax_type|sales_tax|
|» tax_type|service_tax|
|» tax_type|utility_users_tax|
|» tax_type|vat|

## Create a Connection Token

<a id="opIdPostTerminalConnectionTokens"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/connection_tokens \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&location=string'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/connection_tokens`

<p>To connect to a reader the Stripe Terminal SDK needs to retrieve a short-lived connection token from Stripe, proxied through your server. On your backend, add an endpoint that creates and returns a connection token.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
location: string
```

<h3 id="create-a-connection-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» location|body|string|false|The id of the location that this connection token is scoped to. If specified the connection token will only be usable with readers assigned to that location, otherwise the connection token will be usable with all readers. Note that location scoping only applies to internet-connected readers. For more details, see [the docs on scoping connection tokens](https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/locations-and-zones?dashboard-or-api=api#connection-tokens).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "location": "string",
  "object": "terminal.connection_token",
  "secret": "string"
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "error": {
    "advice_code": "string",
    "charge": "string",
    "code": "string",
    "decline_code": "string",
    "doc_url": "string",
    "message": "string",
    "network_advice_code": "string",
    "network_decline_code": "string",
    "param": "string",
    "payment_intent": {},
    "payment_method": {},
    "payment_method_type": "string",
    "request_log_url": "string",
    "setup_intent": {},
    "source": {},
    "type": "api_error"
  }
}
```

|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|

<p>Returns a list of <code>Reader</code> objects.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml

```

<h3 id="list-all-readers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|device_type|query|string|false|Filters readers by device type|
|ending_before|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.|
|expand|query|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|limit|query|integer|false|A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.|
|location|query|string|false|A location ID to filter the response list to only readers at the specific location|
|serial_number|query|string|false|Filters readers by serial number|
|starting_after|query|string|false|A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.|
|status|query|string|false|A status filter to filter readers to only offline or online readers|
|body|body|object|false|none|

<h3 id="list-all-readers-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[[terminal.reader](#schematerminal.reader)]|true|none|A list of readers|
|has_more|boolean|true|none|True if this list has another page of items after this one that can be fetched.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Always has the value `list`.|
|url|string|true|none|The URL where this list can be accessed.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|object|list|

## Create a Reader

<a id="opIdPostTerminalReaders"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/readers \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&label=string&location=string&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&registration_code=string'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/readers`

<p>Creates a new <code>Reader</code> object.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
label: string
location: string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
registration_code: string
```

<h3 id="create-a-reader-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» label|body|string|false|Custom label given to the reader for easier identification. If no label is specified, the registration code will be used.|
|» location|body|string|false|The location to assign the reader to.|
|» metadata|body|object \| string|false|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» registration_code|body|string|true|A code generated by the reader used for registering to an account.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » *anyOf*|""|

## Update a Reader

<a id="opIdPostTerminalReadersReader"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/readers/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&label=string&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}`

<p>Updates a <code>Reader</code> object by setting the values of the parameters passed. Any parameters not provided will be left unchanged.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
label: string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|reader|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» label|body|string|false|The new label of the reader.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» metadata|body|object \| string|false|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » *anyOf*|body|object|false|none|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» » *anyOf*|body|string|false|none|

|---|---|
|» » *anyOf*|""|

## Collect inputs using a Reader

<a id="opIdPostTerminalReadersReaderCollectInputs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/readers/string/collect_inputs \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&inputs=%5B%7B%22custom_text%22%3A%7B%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22skip_button%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22submit_button%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22title%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22required%22%3Atrue%2C%22selection%22%3A%7B%22choices%22%3A%5B%7B%22id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22style%22%3A%22primary%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22string%22%7D%5D%7D%2C%22toggles%22%3A%5B%7B%22default_value%22%3A%22disabled%22%2C%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22title%22%3A%22string%22%7D%5D%2C%22type%22%3A%22email%22%7D%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/collect_inputs`

<p>Initiates an <a href="/docs/terminal/features/collect-inputs">input collection flow</a> on a Reader to display input forms and collect information from your customers.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
inputs:
  -
    custom_text:
      description: string
      skip_button: string
      submit_button: string
      title: string
    required: true
    selection:
      choices:
        -
          id: string
          style: primary
          text: string
    toggles:
      -
        default_value: disabled
        description: string
        title: string
    type: email
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
```

## Hand off a PaymentIntent to a Reader and collect card details

<a id="opIdPostTerminalReadersReaderCollectPaymentMethod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/readers/string/collect_payment_method \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'collect_config=%7B%22allow_redisplay%22%3A%22always%22%2C%22enable_customer_cancellation%22%3Atrue%2C%22skip_tipping%22%3Atrue%2C%22tipping%22%3A%7B%22amount_eligible%22%3A0%7D%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&payment_intent=string'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/collect_payment_method`

<p>Initiates a payment flow on a Reader and updates the PaymentIntent with card details before manual confirmation. See <a href="/docs/terminal/payments/collect-card-payment?terminal-sdk-platform=server-driven&process=inspect#collect-a-paymentmethod">Collecting a Payment method</a> for more details.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
collect_config:
  allow_redisplay: always
  enable_customer_cancellation: true
  skip_tipping: true
  tipping:
    amount_eligible: 0
expand:
  - string
payment_intent: string
```

<h3 id="hand-off-a-paymentintent-to-a-reader-and-collect-card-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|reader|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» collect_config|body|object|false|Configuration overrides for this collection, such as tipping, surcharging, and customer cancellation settings.|
|» » allow_redisplay|body|string|false|none|
|» » enable_customer_cancellation|body|boolean|false|none|
|» » skip_tipping|body|boolean|false|none|
|» » tipping|body|object|false|none|
|» » » amount_eligible|body|integer|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» payment_intent|body|string|true|The ID of the PaymentIntent to collect a payment method for.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » allow_redisplay|always|
|» » allow_redisplay|limited|
|» » allow_redisplay|unspecified|

## Confirm a PaymentIntent on the Reader

<a id="opIdPostTerminalReadersReaderConfirmPaymentIntent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/readers/string/confirm_payment_intent \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'confirm_config=%7B%22return_url%22%3A%22string%22%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&payment_intent=string'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/confirm_payment_intent`

<p>Finalizes a payment on a Reader. See <a href="/docs/terminal/payments/collect-card-payment?terminal-sdk-platform=server-driven&process=inspect#confirm-the-paymentintent">Confirming a Payment</a> for more details.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
confirm_config:
  return_url: string
expand:
  - string
payment_intent: string
```

<h3 id="confirm-a-paymentintent-on-the-reader-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|reader|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» confirm_config|body|object|false|Configuration overrides for this confirmation, such as surcharge settings and return URL.|
|» » return_url|body|string|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» payment_intent|body|string|true|The ID of the PaymentIntent to confirm.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "action": {

      "charge": "string",
      "code": "string",
      "decline_code": "string",
      "doc_url": "string",
```

## Hand-off a PaymentIntent to a Reader

<a id="opIdPostTerminalReadersReaderProcessPaymentIntent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/readers/string/process_payment_intent \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&payment_intent=string&process_config=%7B%22allow_redisplay%22%3A%22always%22%2C%22enable_customer_cancellation%22%3Atrue%2C%22return_url%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22skip_tipping%22%3Atrue%2C%22tipping%22%3A%7B%22amount_eligible%22%3A0%7D%7D'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/process_payment_intent`

<p>Initiates a payment flow on a Reader. See <a href="/docs/terminal/payments/collect-card-payment?terminal-sdk-platform=server-driven&process=immediately#process-payment">process the payment</a> for more details.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
payment_intent: string
process_config:
  allow_redisplay: always
  enable_customer_cancellation: true
  return_url: string
  skip_tipping: true
  tipping:
    amount_eligible: 0
```

<h3 id="hand-off-a-paymentintent-to-a-reader-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|reader|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» payment_intent|body|string|true|The ID of the PaymentIntent to process on the reader.|
|» process_config|body|object|false|Configuration overrides for this transaction, such as tipping and customer cancellation settings.|
|» » allow_redisplay|body|string|false|none|
|» » enable_customer_cancellation|body|boolean|false|none|
|» » return_url|body|string|false|none|
|» » skip_tipping|body|boolean|false|none|
|» » tipping|body|object|false|none|
|» » » amount_eligible|body|integer|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » allow_redisplay|always|
|» » allow_redisplay|limited|
|» » allow_redisplay|unspecified|

## Hand-off a SetupIntent to a Reader

<a id="opIdPostTerminalReadersReaderProcessSetupIntent"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/readers/string/process_setup_intent \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'allow_redisplay=always&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&process_config=%7B%22enable_customer_cancellation%22%3Atrue%7D&setup_intent=string'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/process_setup_intent`

<p>Initiates a SetupIntent flow on a Reader. See <a href="/docs/terminal/features/saving-payment-details/save-directly">Save directly without charging</a> for more details.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
allow_redisplay: always
expand:
  - string
process_config:
  enable_customer_cancellation: true
setup_intent: string
```

<h3 id="hand-off-a-setupintent-to-a-reader-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|reader|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» allow_redisplay|body|string|true|This field indicates whether this payment method can be shown again to its customer in a checkout flow. Stripe products such as Checkout and Elements use this field to determine whether a payment method can be shown as a saved payment method in a checkout flow.|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» process_config|body|object|false|Configuration overrides for this setup, such as MOTO and customer cancellation settings.|
|» » enable_customer_cancellation|body|boolean|false|none|
|» setup_intent|body|string|true|The ID of the SetupIntent to process on the reader.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» allow_redisplay|always|
|» allow_redisplay|limited|
|» allow_redisplay|unspecified|

## Refund a Charge or a PaymentIntent in-person

<a id="opIdPostTerminalReadersReaderRefundPayment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/readers/string/refund_payment \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount=0&charge=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&metadata=%7B%22property1%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22property2%22%3A%22string%22%7D&payment_intent=string&refund_application_fee=true&refund_payment_config=%7B%22enable_customer_cancellation%22%3Atrue%7D&reverse_transfer=true'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/refund_payment`

<p>Initiates an in-person refund on a Reader. See <a href="/docs/terminal/payments/regional?integration-country=CA#refund-an-interac-payment">Refund an Interac Payment</a> for more details.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount: 0
charge: string
expand:
  - string
metadata:
  property1: string
  property2: string
payment_intent: string
refund_application_fee: true
refund_payment_config:
  enable_customer_cancellation: true
reverse_transfer: true
```

<h3 id="refund-a-charge-or-a-paymentintent-in-person-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|reader|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» amount|body|integer|false|A positive integer in __cents__ representing how much of this charge to refund.|
|» charge|body|string|false|ID of the Charge to refund.|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» metadata|body|object|false|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.|
|» » **additionalProperties**|body|string|false|none|
|» payment_intent|body|string|false|ID of the PaymentIntent to refund.|
|» refund_application_fee|body|boolean|false|Boolean indicating whether the application fee should be refunded when refunding this charge. If a full charge refund is given, the full application fee will be refunded. Otherwise, the application fee will be refunded in an amount proportional to the amount of the charge refunded. An application fee can be refunded only by the application that created the charge.|
|» refund_payment_config|body|object|false|Configuration overrides for this refund, such as customer cancellation settings.|
|» » enable_customer_cancellation|body|boolean|false|none|
|» reverse_transfer|body|boolean|false|Boolean indicating whether the transfer should be reversed when refunding this charge. The transfer will be reversed proportionally to the amount being refunded (either the entire or partial amount). A transfer can be reversed only by the application that created the charge.|

## Set reader display

<a id="opIdPostTerminalReadersReaderSetReaderDisplay"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/readers/string/set_reader_display \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'cart=%7B%22currency%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22line_items%22%3A%5B%7B%22amount%22%3A0%2C%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A0%7D%5D%2C%22tax%22%3A0%2C%22total%22%3A0%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&type=cart'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/readers/{reader}/set_reader_display`

<p>Sets the reader display to show <a href="/docs/terminal/features/display">cart details</a>.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
cart:
  currency: string
  line_items:
    -
      amount: 0
      description: string
      quantity: 0
  tax: 0
  total: 0
expand:
  - string
type: cart
```

<h3 id="set-reader-display-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|reader|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» cart|body|object|false|Cart details to display on the reader screen, including line items, amounts, and currency.|
|» » currency|body|string(currency)|true|none|
|» » line_items|body|[object]|true|none|
|» » » amount|body|integer|true|none|
|» » » description|body|string|true|none|
|» » » quantity|body|integer|true|none|
|» » tax|body|integer|false|none|
|» » total|body|integer|true|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» type|body|string|true|Type of information to display. Only `cart` is currently supported.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|cart|

## Create a refund using a Terminal-supported device.

<a id="opIdPostTerminalRefunds"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/terminal/refunds \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D'
```

`POST /v1/terminal/refunds`

<p>Internal endpoint for terminal use to create a refund for a card_present or card charge.</p>

<p>You can optionally refund only part of a charge.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
```

## Fund a test mode cash balance

<a id="opIdPostTestHelpersCustomersCustomerFundCashBalance"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/customers/string/fund_cash_balance \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount=0&currency=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&reference=string'
```

`POST /v1/test_helpers/customers/{customer}/fund_cash_balance`

<p>Create an incoming testmode bank transfer</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount: 0
currency: string
expand:
  - string
reference: string
```

<h3 id="fund-a-test-mode-cash-balance-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» amount|body|integer|true|Amount to be used for this test cash balance transaction. A positive integer representing how much to fund in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal) (e.g., 100 cents to fund $1.00 or 100 to fund ¥100, a zero-decimal currency).|
|» currency|body|string(currency)|true|Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» reference|body|string|false|A description of the test funding. This simulates free-text references supplied by customers when making bank transfers to their cash balance. You can use this to test how Stripe's [reconciliation algorithm](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/customer-balance/reconciliation) applies to different user inputs.|

## Create a test-mode authorization

<a id="opIdPostTestHelpersIssuingAuthorizations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/issuing/authorizations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount=0&amount_details=%7B%22atm_fee%22%3A0%2C%22cashback_amount%22%3A0%7D&authorization_method=chip&card=string&currency=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&fleet=%7B%22cardholder_prompt_data%22%3A%7B%22driver_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22odometer%22%3A0%2C%22unspecified_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22user_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22vehicle_number%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22purchase_type%22%3A%22fuel_and_non_fuel_purchase%22%2C%22reported_breakdown%22%3A%7B%22fuel%22%3A%7B%22gross_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22non_fuel%22%3A%7B%22gross_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22tax%22%3A%7B%22local_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22national_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%7D%2C%22service_type%22%3A%22full_service%22%7D&fraud_disputability_likelihood=neutral&fuel=%7B%22industry_product_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22quantity_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22diesel%22%2C%22unit%22%3A%22charging_minute%22%2C%22unit_cost_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D&is_amount_controllable=true&merchant_amount=0&merchant_currency=string&merchant_data=%7B%22category%22%3A%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%2C%22city%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22network_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22postal_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22terminal_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22string%22%7D&network_data=%7B%22acquiring_institution_id%22%3A%22string%22%7D&risk_assessment=%7B%22card_testing_risk%22%3A%7B%22invalid_account_number_decline_rate_past_hour%22%3A0%2C%22invalid_credentials_decline_rate_past_hour%22%3A0%2C%22level%22%3A%22elevated%22%7D%2C%22fraud_risk%22%3A%7B%22level%22%3A%22elevated%22%2C%22score%22%3A0%7D%2C%22merchant_dispute_risk%22%3A%7B%22dispute_rate%22%3A0%2C%22level%22%3A%22elevated%22%7D%7D&verification_data=%7B%22address_line1_check%22%3A%22match%22%2C%22address_postal_code_check%22%3A%22match%22%2C%22authentication_exemption%22%3A%7B%22claimed_by%22%3A%22acquirer%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22low_value_transaction%22%7D%2C%22cvc_check%22%3A%22match%22%2C%22expiry_check%22%3A%22match%22%2C%22three_d_secure%22%3A%7B%22result%22%3A%22attempt_acknowledged%22%7D%7D&wallet=apple_pay'
```

`POST /v1/test_helpers/issuing/authorizations`

<p>Create a test-mode authorization.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount: 0
amount_details:
  atm_fee: 0
  cashback_amount: 0
authorization_method: chip
card: string
currency: string
expand:
  - string
fleet:
  cardholder_prompt_data:
    driver_id: string
    odometer: 0
    unspecified_id: string
    user_id: string
    vehicle_number: string
  purchase_type: fuel_and_non_fuel_purchase
  reported_breakdown:
    fuel:
      gross_amount_decimal: string
    non_fuel:
      gross_amount_decimal: string
    tax:
      local_amount_decimal: string
      national_amount_decimal: string
  service_type: full_service
fraud_disputability_likelihood: neutral
fuel:
  industry_product_code: string
  quantity_decimal: string
  type: diesel
  unit: charging_minute
  unit_cost_decimal: string
is_amount_controllable: true
merchant_amount: 0
merchant_currency: string
merchant_data:
  category: ac_refrigeration_repair
  city: string
  country: string
  name: string
  network_id: string
  postal_code: string
  state: string
  terminal_id: string
  url: string
network_data:
  acquiring_institution_id: string
risk_assessment:
  card_testing_risk:
    invalid_account_number_decline_rate_past_hour: 0
    invalid_credentials_decline_rate_past_hour: 0
    level: elevated
  fraud_risk:
    level: elevated
    score: 0
  merchant_dispute_risk:
    dispute_rate: 0
    level: elevated
verification_data:
  address_line1_check: match
  address_postal_code_check: match
  authentication_exemption:
    claimed_by: acquirer
    type: low_value_transaction
  cvc_check: match
  expiry_check: match
  three_d_secure:
    result: attempt_acknowledged
wallet: apple_pay
```

<h3 id="create-a-test-mode-authorization-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» amount|body|integer|false|The total amount to attempt to authorize. This amount is in the provided currency, or defaults to the card's currency, and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|
|» amount_details|body|object|false|Detailed breakdown of amount components. These amounts are denominated in `currency` and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|
|» » atm_fee|body|integer|false|none|
|» » cashback_amount|body|integer|false|none|
|» authorization_method|body|string|false|How the card details were provided. Defaults to online.|
|» card|body|string|true|Card associated with this authorization.|
|» currency|body|string(currency)|false|The currency of the authorization. If not provided, defaults to the currency of the card. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» fleet|body|object|false|Fleet-specific information for authorizations using Fleet cards.|
|» » cardholder_prompt_data|body|object|false|none|
|» » » driver_id|body|string|false|none|
|» » » odometer|body|integer|false|none|
|» » » unspecified_id|body|string|false|none|
|» » » user_id|body|string|false|none|
|» » » vehicle_number|body|string|false|none|
|» » purchase_type|body|string|false|none|
|» » reported_breakdown|body|object|false|none|
|» » » fuel|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » gross_amount_decimal|body|string(decimal)|false|none|
|» » » non_fuel|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » gross_amount_decimal|body|string(decimal)|false|none|
|» » » tax|body|object|false|none|
|» » » » local_amount_decimal|body|string(decimal)|false|none|
|» » » » national_amount_decimal|body|string(decimal)|false|none|
|» » service_type|body|string|false|none|
|» fraud_disputability_likelihood|body|string|false|Probability that this transaction can be disputed in the event of fraud. Assessed by comparing the characteristics of the authorization to card network rules.|
|» fuel|body|object|false|Information about fuel that was purchased with this transaction.|
|» » industry_product_code|body|string|false|none|
|» » quantity_decimal|body|string(decimal)|false|none|
|» » type|body|string|false|none|
|» » unit|body|string|false|none|
|» » unit_cost_decimal|body|string(decimal)|false|none|
|» is_amount_controllable|body|boolean|false|If set `true`, you may provide [amount](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/authorizations/approve#approve_issuing_authorization-amount) to control how much to hold for the authorization.|
|» merchant_amount|body|integer|false|The total amount to attempt to authorize. This amount is in the provided merchant currency, and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|
|» merchant_currency|body|string(currency)|false|The currency of the authorization. If not provided, defaults to the currency of the card. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|» merchant_data|body|object|false|Details about the seller (grocery store, e-commerce website, etc.) where the card authorization happened.|
|» » category|body|string|false|none|
|» » city|body|string|false|none|
|» » country|body|string|false|none|
|» » name|body|string|false|none|
|» » network_id|body|string|false|none|
|» » postal_code|body|string|false|none|
|» » state|body|string|false|none|
|» » terminal_id|body|string|false|none|
|» » url|body|string|false|none|
|» network_data|body|object|false|Details about the authorization, such as identifiers, set by the card network.|
|» » acquiring_institution_id|body|string|false|none|

<h3 id="create-a-test-mode-authorization-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response.|[issuing.authorization](#schemaissuing.authorization)|
|default|Default|Error response.|[error](#schemaerror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
basicAuth, bearerAuth
</aside>

## Capture a test-mode authorization

<a id="opIdPostTestHelpersIssuingAuthorizationsAuthorizationCapture"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/issuing/authorizations/string/capture \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
```

`POST /v1/test_helpers/issuing/authorizations/{authorization}/capture`

<p>Capture a test-mode authorization.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
capture_amount: 0
close_authorization: true
expand:
  - string
purchase_details:
  fleet:
    cardholder_prompt_data:
      driver_id: string
      odometer: 0
      unspecified_id: string
      user_id: string
      vehicle_number: string
    purchase_type: fuel_and_non_fuel_purchase
    reported_breakdown:
      fuel:
        gross_amount_decimal: string
      non_fuel:
        gross_amount_decimal: string
      tax:
        local_amount_decimal: string
        national_amount_decimal: string
    service_type: full_service
  flight:
    departure_at: 0
    passenger_name: string
    refundable: true
    segments:
      -
        arrival_airport_code: str
        carrier: string
        departure_airport_code: str
        flight_number: string
        service_class: string
        stopover_allowed: true
    travel_agency: string
  fuel:
    industry_product_code: string
    quantity_decimal: string
    type: diesel
    unit: charging_minute
    unit_cost_decimal: string
  lodging:
    check_in_at: 0
    nights: 0
  receipt:
    -
      description: string
      quantity: string
      total: 0
      unit_cost: 0
  reference: string
```

## Respond to fraud challenge

<a id="opIdPostTestHelpersIssuingAuthorizationsAuthorizationFraudChallengesRespond"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/issuing/authorizations/string/fraud_challenges/respond \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'confirmed=true&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D'
```

`POST /v1/test_helpers/issuing/authorizations/{authorization}/fraud_challenges/respond`

<p>Respond to a fraud challenge on a testmode Issuing authorization, simulating either a confirmation of fraud or a correction of legitimacy.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
confirmed: true
expand:
```

|body|body|object|true|none|
|» confirmed|body|boolean|true|Whether to simulate the user confirming that the transaction was legitimate (true) or telling Stripe that it was fraudulent (false).|

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/issuing/authorizations/string/increment \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&increment_amount=0&is_amount_controllable=true'
```

```yaml
expand:

increment_amount: 0
```

## Create a test-mode settlement

<a id="opIdPostTestHelpersIssuingSettlements"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/issuing/settlements \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'bin=string&clearing_date=0&currency=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&interchange_fees_amount=0&net_total_amount=0&network=maestro&network_settlement_identifier=string&transaction_amount=0&transaction_count=0'
```

`POST /v1/test_helpers/issuing/settlements`

<p>Allows the user to create an Issuing settlement.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
bin: string
clearing_date: 0
currency: string
expand:
  - string
interchange_fees_amount: 0
net_total_amount: 0
network: maestro
network_settlement_identifier: string
transaction_amount: 0
transaction_count: 0
```

<h3 id="create-a-test-mode-settlement-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» bin|body|string|true|The Bank Identification Number reflecting this settlement record.|
|» clearing_date|body|integer|true|The date that the transactions are cleared and posted to user's accounts.|
|» currency|body|string(currency)|true|Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» interchange_fees_amount|body|integer|false|The total interchange received as reimbursement for the transactions.|
|» net_total_amount|body|integer|true|The total net amount required to settle with the network.|
|» network|body|string|false|The card network for this settlement. One of ["visa", "maestro", "mastercard"]|
|» network_settlement_identifier|body|string|false|The Settlement Identification Number assigned by the network.|
|» transaction_amount|body|integer|false|The total transaction amount reflected in this settlement.|
|» transaction_count|body|integer|false|The total number of transactions reflected in this settlement.|

#### Enumerated Values

|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|

## Create a test-mode force capture

<a id="opIdPostTestHelpersIssuingTransactionsCreateForceCapture"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/issuing/transactions/create_force_capture \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount=0&card=string&currency=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&merchant_data=%7B%22category%22%3A%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%2C%22city%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22network_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22postal_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22terminal_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22string%22%7D&purchase_details=%7B%22fleet%22%3A%7B%22cardholder_prompt_data%22%3A%7B%22driver_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22odometer%22%3A0%2C%22unspecified_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22user_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22vehicle_number%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22purchase_type%22%3A%22fuel_and_non_fuel_purchase%22%2C%22reported_breakdown%22%3A%7B%22fuel%22%3A%7B%22gross_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22non_fuel%22%3A%7B%22gross_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22tax%22%3A%7B%22local_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22national_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%7D%2C%22service_type%22%3A%22full_service%22%7D%2C%22flight%22%3A%7B%22departure_at%22%3A0%2C%22passenger_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22refundable%22%3Atrue%2C%22segments%22%3A%5B%7B%22arrival_airport_code%22%3A%22str%22%2C%22carrier%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22departure_airport_code%22%3A%22str%22%2C%22flight_number%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22service_class%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22stopover_allowed%22%3Atrue%7D%5D%2C%22travel_agency%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22fuel%22%3A%7B%22industry_product_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22quantity_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22diesel%22%2C%22unit%22%3A%22charging_minute%22%2C%22unit_cost_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22lodging%22%3A%7B%22check_in_at%22%3A0%2C%22nights%22%3A0%7D%2C%22receipt%22%3A%5B%7B%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22total%22%3A0%2C%22unit_cost%22%3A0%7D%5D%2C%22reference%22%3A%22string%22%7D'
```

`POST /v1/test_helpers/issuing/transactions/create_force_capture`

<p>Allows the user to capture an arbitrary amount, also known as a forced capture.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount: 0
card: string
currency: string
expand:
  - string
merchant_data:
  category: ac_refrigeration_repair
  city: string
  country: string
  name: string
  network_id: string
  postal_code: string
  state: string
  terminal_id: string
  url: string
purchase_details:
  fleet:
    cardholder_prompt_data:
      driver_id: string
      odometer: 0
      unspecified_id: string
      user_id: string
      vehicle_number: string
    purchase_type: fuel_and_non_fuel_purchase
    reported_breakdown:
      fuel:
        gross_amount_decimal: string
      non_fuel:
        gross_amount_decimal: string
      tax:
        local_amount_decimal: string
        national_amount_decimal: string
    service_type: full_service
  flight:
    departure_at: 0
    passenger_name: string
    refundable: true
    segments:
      -
        arrival_airport_code: str
        carrier: string
        departure_airport_code: str
        flight_number: string
        service_class: string
        stopover_allowed: true
    travel_agency: string
  fuel:
    industry_product_code: string
    quantity_decimal: string
    type: diesel
    unit: charging_minute
    unit_cost_decimal: string
  lodging:
    check_in_at: 0
    nights: 0
  receipt:
    -
      description: string
      quantity: string
      total: 0
      unit_cost: 0
  reference: string
```

|» card|body|string|true|Card associated with this transaction.|
|» currency|body|string(currency)|false|The currency of the capture. If not provided, defaults to the currency of the card. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|

## Create a test-mode unlinked refund

<a id="opIdPostTestHelpersIssuingTransactionsCreateUnlinkedRefund"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/issuing/transactions/create_unlinked_refund \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount=0&card=string&currency=string&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&merchant_data=%7B%22category%22%3A%22ac_refrigeration_repair%22%2C%22city%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22country%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22network_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22postal_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22state%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22terminal_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22url%22%3A%22string%22%7D&purchase_details=%7B%22fleet%22%3A%7B%22cardholder_prompt_data%22%3A%7B%22driver_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22odometer%22%3A0%2C%22unspecified_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22user_id%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22vehicle_number%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22purchase_type%22%3A%22fuel_and_non_fuel_purchase%22%2C%22reported_breakdown%22%3A%7B%22fuel%22%3A%7B%22gross_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22non_fuel%22%3A%7B%22gross_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22tax%22%3A%7B%22local_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22national_amount_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%7D%2C%22service_type%22%3A%22full_service%22%7D%2C%22flight%22%3A%7B%22departure_at%22%3A0%2C%22passenger_name%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22refundable%22%3Atrue%2C%22segments%22%3A%5B%7B%22arrival_airport_code%22%3A%22str%22%2C%22carrier%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22departure_airport_code%22%3A%22str%22%2C%22flight_number%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22service_class%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22stopover_allowed%22%3Atrue%7D%5D%2C%22travel_agency%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22fuel%22%3A%7B%22industry_product_code%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22quantity_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22diesel%22%2C%22unit%22%3A%22charging_minute%22%2C%22unit_cost_decimal%22%3A%22string%22%7D%2C%22lodging%22%3A%7B%22check_in_at%22%3A0%2C%22nights%22%3A0%7D%2C%22receipt%22%3A%5B%7B%22description%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22quantity%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22total%22%3A0%2C%22unit_cost%22%3A0%7D%5D%2C%22reference%22%3A%22string%22%7D'
```

`POST /v1/test_helpers/issuing/transactions/create_unlinked_refund`

<p>Allows the user to refund an arbitrary amount, also known as a unlinked refund.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount: 0
card: string
currency: string
expand:
  - string
merchant_data:
  category: ac_refrigeration_repair
  city: string
  country: string
  name: string
  network_id: string
  postal_code: string
  state: string
  terminal_id: string
  url: string
purchase_details:
  fleet:
    cardholder_prompt_data:
      driver_id: string
      odometer: 0
      unspecified_id: string
      user_id: string
      vehicle_number: string
    purchase_type: fuel_and_non_fuel_purchase
    reported_breakdown:
      fuel:
        gross_amount_decimal: string
      non_fuel:
        gross_amount_decimal: string
      tax:
        local_amount_decimal: string
        national_amount_decimal: string
    service_type: full_service
  flight:
    departure_at: 0
    passenger_name: string
    refundable: true
    segments:
      -
        arrival_airport_code: str
        carrier: string
        departure_airport_code: str
        flight_number: string
        service_class: string
        stopover_allowed: true
    travel_agency: string
  fuel:
    industry_product_code: string
    quantity_decimal: string
    type: diesel
    unit: charging_minute
    unit_cost_decimal: string
  lodging:
    check_in_at: 0
    nights: 0
  receipt:
    -
      description: string
      quantity: string
      total: 0
      unit_cost: 0
  reference: string
```

<h3 id="create-a-test-mode-unlinked-refund-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» amount|body|integer|true|The total amount to attempt to refund. This amount is in the provided currency, or defaults to the cards currency, and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|
|» card|body|string|true|Card associated with this unlinked refund transaction.|
|» currency|body|string(currency)|false|The currency of the unlinked refund. If not provided, defaults to the currency of the card. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» merchant_data|body|object|false|Details about the seller (grocery store, e-commerce website, etc.) where the card authorization happened.|

## Refund a test-mode transaction

<a id="opIdPostTestHelpersIssuingTransactionsTransactionRefund"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/issuing/transactions/string/refund \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&refund_amount=0'
```

`POST /v1/test_helpers/issuing/transactions/{transaction}/refund`

<p>Refund a test-mode Transaction.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
expand:
  - string
refund_amount: 0
```

<h3 id="refund-a-test-mode-transaction-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|transaction|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» refund_amount|body|integer|false|The total amount to attempt to refund. This amount is in the provided currency, or defaults to the cards currency, and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|

## Simulate presenting a payment method

<a id="opIdPostTestHelpersTerminalReadersReaderPresentPaymentMethod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.stripe.com/v1/test_helpers/terminal/readers/string/present_payment_method \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d 'amount_tip=0&card=%7B%22cvc%22%3A%22string%22%2C%22exp_month%22%3A0%2C%22exp_year%22%3A0%2C%22number%22%3A%22string%22%7D&card_present=%7B%22number%22%3A%22string%22%7D&expand=%5B%22string%22%5D&interac_present=%7B%22number%22%3A%22string%22%7D&type=card'
```

`POST /v1/test_helpers/terminal/readers/{reader}/present_payment_method`

<p>Presents a payment method on a simulated reader. Can be used to simulate accepting a payment, saving a card or refunding a transaction.</p>

> Body parameter

```yaml
amount_tip: 0
card:
  cvc: string
  exp_month: 0
  exp_year: 0
  number: string
card_present:
  number: string
expand:
  - string
interac_present:
  number: string
type: card
```

<h3 id="simulate-presenting-a-payment-method-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|reader|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» amount_tip|body|integer|false|Simulated on-reader tip amount.|
|» card|body|object|false|Simulated data for the card payment method.|
|» » cvc|body|string|false|none|
|» » exp_month|body|integer|true|none|
|» » exp_year|body|integer|true|none|
|» » number|body|string|true|none|
|» card_present|body|object|false|Simulated data for the card_present payment method.|
|» » number|body|string|false|none|
|» expand|body|[string]|false|Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.|
|» interac_present|body|object|false|Simulated data for the interac_present payment method.|
|» » number|body|string|false|none|
|» type|body|string|false|Simulated payment type.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|card|
|» type|card_present|
|» type|interac_present|
