<h2 id="tocS_invoiceitem">invoiceitem</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemainvoiceitem"></a>
<a id="schema_invoiceitem"></a>
<a id="tocSinvoiceitem"></a>
<a id="tocsinvoiceitem"></a>

```json
{
  "amount": 0,
  "currency": "string",
  "customer": "string",
  "customer_account": "string",
  "date": 0,
  "description": "string",
  "discountable": true,
  "discounts": [
    "string"
  ],
  "frozen_fields": [
    "discounts"
  ],
  "id": "string",
  "invoice": "string",
  "invoicing_rules": [
    {
      "type": "defer_until_credited_items_resolved"
    }
  ],
  "livemode": true,
  "metadata": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "net_amount": 0,
  "object": "invoiceitem",
  "parent": {
    "subscription_details": {
      "subscription": "string",
      "subscription_item": "string"
    },
    "type": "subscription_details"
  },
  "period": {
    "end": 0,
    "start": 0
  },
  "pricing": {
    "price_details": {
      "price": "string",
      "product": "string"
    },
    "type": "price_details",
    "unit_amount_decimal": "string"
  },
  "proration": true,
  "proration_details": {
    "credited_items": {
      "invoice_item": "string",
      "invoice_line_item_details": {
        "invoice": "string",
        "invoice_line_items": [
          "string"
        ]
      },
      "type": "invoice_item"
    },
    "discount_amounts": [
      {
        "amount": 0,
        "discount": "string"
      }
    ]
  },
  "quantity": 0,
  "quantity_decimal": "string",
  "tax_rates": [
    {
      "active": true,
      "country": "string",
      "created": 0,
      "description": "string",
      "display_name": "string",
      "effective_percentage": 0,
      "flat_amount": {
        "amount": 0,
        "currency": "string"
      },
      "id": "string",
      "inclusive": true,
      "jurisdiction": "string",
      "jurisdiction_level": "city",
      "livemode": true,
      "metadata": {
        "property1": "string",
        "property2": "string"
      },
      "object": "tax_rate",
      "percentage": 0,
      "rate_type": "flat_amount",
      "state": "string",
      "tax_type": "amusement_tax"
    }
  ],
  "test_clock": "string"
}
```

Invoice Items represent the component lines of an [invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices). When you create an invoice item with an `invoice` field, it is attached to the specified invoice and included as [an invoice line item](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/line_item) within [invoice.lines](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/object#invoice_object-lines).

Invoice Items can be created before you are ready to actually send the invoice. This can be particularly useful when combined
with a [subscription](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions). Sometimes you want to add a charge or credit to a customer, but actually charge
or credit the customer's card only at the end of a regular billing cycle. This is useful for combining several charges
(to minimize per-transaction fees), or for having Stripe tabulate your usage-based billing totals.

Related guides: [Integrate with the Invoicing API](https://docs.stripe.com/invoicing/integration), [Subscription Invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/invoices/subscription#adding-upcoming-invoice-items).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer|true|none|Amount (in the `currency` specified) of the invoice item. This should always be equal to `unit_amount * quantity`.|
|currency|string(currency)|true|none|Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|customer|string \| [customer](#schemacustomer) \| [deleted_customer](#schemadeleted_customer)|true|none|The ID of the customer to bill for this invoice item.|
|customer_account|string \| null|false|none|The ID of the account to bill for this invoice item.|
|date|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.|
|discountable|boolean|true|none|If true, discounts will apply to this invoice item. Always false for prorations.|
|discounts|[string \| [discount](#schemadiscount)]|false|none|The discounts which apply to the invoice item. Item discounts are applied before invoice discounts. Use `expand[]=discounts` to expand each discount.|
|frozen_fields|[string]|false|none|Array of field names that can't be modified. Attempting to update a frozen field returns an error.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|invoice|string \| [invoice](#schemainvoice) \| null|false|none|The ID of the invoice this invoice item belongs to.|
|invoicing_rules|[[invoicing_rule](#schemainvoicing_rule)]|false|none|The rules that control when this invoice item is eligible for invoicing. All rules must be satisfied for the item to be invoiced.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|metadata|object \| null|false|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.|
|net_amount|integer|false|none|The amount after discounts, but before credits and taxes. This field is `null` for `discountable=true` items.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|parent|[billing_bill_resource_invoice_item_parents_invoice_item_parent](#schemabilling_bill_resource_invoice_item_parents_invoice_item_parent) \| null|false|none|The parent that generated this invoice item.|
|period|[invoice_line_item_period](#schemainvoice_line_item_period)|true|none|none|
|pricing|[billing_bill_resource_invoicing_pricing_pricing](#schemabilling_bill_resource_invoicing_pricing_pricing) \| null|false|none|The pricing information of the invoice item.|
|proration|boolean|true|none|Whether the invoice item was created automatically as a proration adjustment when the customer switched plans.|
|proration_details|[proration_details](#schemaproration_details)|false|none|none|
|quantity|integer|true|none|Quantity of units for the invoice item in integer format, with any decimal precision truncated. For the item's full-precision decimal quantity, use `quantity_decimal`. This field will be deprecated in favor of `quantity_decimal` in a future version. If the invoice item is a proration, the quantity of the subscription that the proration was computed for.|
|quantity_decimal|string(decimal)|true|none|Non-negative decimal with at most 12 decimal places. The quantity of units for the invoice item.|
|tax_rates|[[tax_rate](#schematax_rate)]|false|none|The tax rates which apply to the invoice item. When set, the `default_tax_rates` on the invoice do not apply to this invoice item.|
|test_clock|string \| [test_helpers.test_clock](#schematest_helpers.test_clock) \| null|false|none|ID of the test clock this invoice item belongs to.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|frozen_fields|discounts|
|frozen_fields|pricing|
|frozen_fields|quantity|
|object|invoiceitem|

When an [issued card](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing) is used to make a purchase, an Issuing `Authorization`
object is created. [Authorizations](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/purchases/authorizations) must be approved for the
purchase to be completed successfully.

Related guide: [Issued card authorizations](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/purchases/authorizations)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer|true|none|The total amount that was authorized or rejected. This amount is in `currency` and in the [smallest currency unit](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#zero-decimal). `amount` should be the same as `merchant_amount`, unless `currency` and `merchant_currency` are different.|
|amount_details|[issuing_authorization_amount_details](#schemaissuing_authorization_amount_details) \| null|false|none|Detailed breakdown of amount components. These amounts are denominated in `currency` and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|
|approved|boolean|true|none|Whether the authorization has been approved.|
|authorization_method|string|true|none|How the card details were provided.|
|balance_transactions|[[balance_transaction](#schemabalance_transaction)]|true|none|List of balance transactions associated with this authorization.|
|card|[issuing.card](#schemaissuing.card)|true|none|You can [create physical or virtual cards](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing) that are issued to cardholders.|
|card_presence|string \| null|false|none|Whether the card was present at the point of sale for the authorization.|
|cardholder|string \| [issuing.cardholder](#schemaissuing.cardholder) \| null|false|none|The cardholder to whom this authorization belongs.|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|currency|string(currency)|true|none|The currency of the cardholder. This currency can be different from the currency presented at authorization and the `merchant_currency` field on this authorization. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|fleet|[issuing_authorization_fleet_data](#schemaissuing_authorization_fleet_data) \| null|false|none|Fleet-specific information for authorizations using Fleet cards.|
|fraud_challenges|[[issuing_authorization_fraud_challenge](#schemaissuing_authorization_fraud_challenge)]|false|none|Fraud challenges sent to the cardholder, if this authorization was declined for fraud risk reasons.|
|fuel|[issuing_authorization_fuel_data](#schemaissuing_authorization_fuel_data) \| null|false|none|Information about fuel that was purchased with this transaction. Typically this information is received from the merchant after the authorization has been approved and the fuel dispensed.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|merchant_amount|integer|true|none|The total amount that was authorized or rejected. This amount is in the `merchant_currency` and in the [smallest currency unit](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies#zero-decimal). `merchant_amount` should be the same as `amount`, unless `merchant_currency` and `currency` are different.|
|merchant_currency|string(currency)|true|none|The local currency that was presented to the cardholder for the authorization. This currency can be different from the cardholder currency and the `currency` field on this authorization. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|merchant_data|[issuing_authorization_merchant_data](#schemaissuing_authorization_merchant_data)|true|none|none|
|metadata|object|true|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.|
|network_data|[issuing_authorization_network_data](#schemaissuing_authorization_network_data) \| null|false|none|Details about the authorization, such as identifiers, set by the card network.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|pending_request|[issuing_authorization_pending_request](#schemaissuing_authorization_pending_request) \| null|false|none|The pending authorization request. This field will only be non-null during an `issuing_authorization.request` webhook.|
|request_history|[[issuing_authorization_request](#schemaissuing_authorization_request)]|true|none|History of every time a `pending_request` authorization was approved/declined, either by you directly or by Stripe (e.g. based on your spending_controls). If the merchant changes the authorization by performing an incremental authorization, you can look at this field to see the previous requests for the authorization. This field can be helpful in determining why a given authorization was approved/declined.|
|status|string|true|none|The current status of the authorization in its lifecycle.|
|token|string \| [issuing.token](#schemaissuing.token) \| null|false|none|[Token](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/tokens/object) object used for this authorization. If a network token was not used for this authorization, this field will be null.|
|transactions|[[issuing.transaction](#schemaissuing.transaction)]|true|none|List of [transactions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/transactions) associated with this authorization.|
|treasury|[issuing_authorization_treasury](#schemaissuing_authorization_treasury) \| null|false|none|[Treasury](https://docs.stripe.com/api/treasury) details related to this authorization if it was created on a [FinancialAccount](https://docs.stripe.com/api/treasury/financial_accounts).|
|verification_data|[issuing_authorization_verification_data](#schemaissuing_authorization_verification_data)|true|none|none|
|verified_by_fraud_challenge|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether the authorization bypassed fraud risk checks because the cardholder has previously completed a fraud challenge on a similar high-risk authorization from the same merchant.|
|wallet|string \| null|false|none|The digital wallet used for this transaction. One of `apple_pay`, `google_pay`, or `samsung_pay`. Will populate as `null` when no digital wallet was utilized.|

|authorization_method|chip|
|authorization_method|contactless|
|authorization_method|keyed_in|
|authorization_method|online|
|authorization_method|swipe|
|card_presence|not_present|
|card_presence|present|
|object|issuing.authorization|
|status|closed|
|status|expired|
|status|pending|
|status|reversed|

You can [create physical or virtual cards](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing) that are issued to cardholders.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|brand|string|true|none|The brand of the card.|
|cancellation_reason|string \| null|false|none|The reason why the card was canceled.|
|cardholder|[issuing.cardholder](#schemaissuing.cardholder)|true|none|An Issuing `Cardholder` object represents an individual or business entity who is [issued](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing) cards.<br><br>Related guide: [How to create a cardholder](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/cards/virtual/issue-cards#create-cardholder)|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|currency|string(currency)|true|none|Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Supported currencies are `usd` in the US, `eur` in the EU, and `gbp` in the UK.|
|cvc|string|false|none|The card's CVC. For security reasons, this is only available for virtual cards, and will be omitted unless you explicitly request it with [the `expand` parameter](https://docs.stripe.com/api/expanding_objects). Additionally, it's only available via the ["Retrieve a card" endpoint](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/cards/retrieve), not via "List all cards" or any other endpoint.|
|exp_month|integer|true|none|The expiration month of the card.|
|exp_year|integer|true|none|The expiration year of the card.|
|financial_account|string \| null|false|none|The financial account this card is attached to.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|last4|string|true|none|The last 4 digits of the card number.|
|latest_fraud_warning|[issuing_card_fraud_warning](#schemaissuing_card_fraud_warning) \| null|false|none|Stripe’s assessment of whether this card’s details have been compromised. If this property isn't null, cancel and reissue the card to prevent fraudulent activity risk.|
|lifecycle_controls|[issuing_card_lifecycle_controls](#schemaissuing_card_lifecycle_controls) \| null|false|none|Rules that control the lifecycle of this card, such as automatic cancellation. Refer to our [documentation](/issuing/controls/lifecycle-controls) for more details.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|metadata|object|true|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.|
|number|string|false|none|The full unredacted card number. For security reasons, this is only available for virtual cards, and will be omitted unless you explicitly request it with [the `expand` parameter](https://docs.stripe.com/api/expanding_objects). Additionally, it's only available via the ["Retrieve a card" endpoint](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/cards/retrieve), not via "List all cards" or any other endpoint.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|personalization_design|string \| [issuing.personalization_design](#schemaissuing.personalization_design) \| null|false|none|The personalization design object belonging to this card.|
|replaced_by|string \| [issuing.card](#schemaissuing.card) \| null|false|none|The latest card that replaces this card, if any.|
|replacement_for|string \| [issuing.card](#schemaissuing.card) \| null|false|none|The card this card replaces, if any.|
|replacement_reason|string \| null|false|none|The reason why the previous card needed to be replaced.|
|second_line|string \| null|false|none|Text separate from cardholder name, printed on the card.|
|shipping|[issuing_card_shipping](#schemaissuing_card_shipping) \| null|false|none|Where and how the card will be shipped.|
|spending_controls|[issuing_card_authorization_controls](#schemaissuing_card_authorization_controls)|true|none|none|
|status|string|true|none|Whether authorizations can be approved on this card. May be blocked from activating cards depending on past-due Cardholder requirements. Defaults to `inactive`.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the card.|
|wallets|[issuing_card_wallets](#schemaissuing_card_wallets) \| null|false|none|Information relating to digital wallets (like Apple Pay and Google Pay).|

An Issuing `Cardholder` object represents an individual or business entity who is [issued](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing) cards.

Related guide: [How to create a cardholder](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/cards/virtual/issue-cards#create-cardholder)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|billing|[issuing_cardholder_address](#schemaissuing_cardholder_address)|true|none|none|
|company|[issuing_cardholder_company](#schemaissuing_cardholder_company) \| null|false|none|Additional information about a `company` cardholder.|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|email|string \| null|false|none|The cardholder's email address.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|individual|[issuing_cardholder_individual](#schemaissuing_cardholder_individual) \| null|false|none|Additional information about an `individual` cardholder.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|metadata|object|true|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.|
|name|string|true|none|The cardholder's name. This will be printed on cards issued to them.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|phone_number|string \| null|false|none|The cardholder's phone number. This is required for all cardholders who will be creating EU cards. See the [3D Secure documentation](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/3d-secure#when-is-3d-secure-applied) for more details.|
|preferred_locales|[string]|false|none|The cardholder’s preferred locales (languages), ordered by preference. Locales can be `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, or `it`.<br> This changes the language of the [3D Secure flow](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/3d-secure) and one-time password messages sent to the cardholder.|
|requirements|[issuing_cardholder_requirements](#schemaissuing_cardholder_requirements)|true|none|none|
|spending_controls|[issuing_cardholder_authorization_controls](#schemaissuing_cardholder_authorization_controls) \| null|false|none|Rules that control spending across this cardholder's cards. Refer to our [documentation](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/controls/spending-controls) for more details.|
|status|string|true|none|Specifies whether to permit authorizations on this cardholder's cards.|
|type|string|true|none|One of `individual` or `company`. See [Choose a cardholder type](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/other/choose-cardholder) for more details.|

As a [card issuer](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing), you can dispute transactions that the cardholder does not recognize, suspects to be fraudulent, or has other issues with.

Related guide: [Issuing disputes](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/purchases/disputes)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer|true|none|Disputed amount in the card's currency and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal). Usually the amount of the `transaction`, but can differ (usually because of currency fluctuation).|
|balance_transactions|[[balance_transaction](#schemabalance_transaction)]|false|none|List of balance transactions associated with the dispute.|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|currency|string(currency)|true|none|The currency the `transaction` was made in.|
|evidence|[issuing_dispute_evidence](#schemaissuing_dispute_evidence)|true|none|none|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|loss_reason|string|false|none|The enum that describes the dispute loss outcome. If the dispute is not lost, this field will be absent. New enum values may be added in the future, so be sure to handle unknown values.|
|metadata|object|true|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|status|string|true|none|Current status of the dispute.|
|transaction|string \| [issuing.transaction](#schemaissuing.transaction)|true|none|The transaction being disputed.|
|treasury|[issuing_dispute_treasury](#schemaissuing_dispute_treasury) \| null|false|none|[Treasury](https://docs.stripe.com/api/treasury) details related to this dispute if it was created on a [FinancialAccount](https://docs.stripe.com/api/treasury/financial_accounts)|

A Personalization Design is a logical grouping of a Physical Bundle, card logo, and carrier text that represents a product line.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|card_logo|string \| [file](#schemafile) \| null|false|none|The file for the card logo to use with physical bundles that support card logos. Must have a `purpose` value of `issuing_logo`. Image must be in PNG format with dimensions of 1000px by 200px. It must be a binary (black and white) image containing a black logo on a white background. We don't accept grayscale.|
|carrier_text|[issuing_personalization_design_carrier_text](#schemaissuing_personalization_design_carrier_text) \| null|false|none|Hash containing carrier text, for use with physical bundles that support carrier text.|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|lookup_key|string \| null|false|none|A lookup key used to retrieve personalization designs dynamically from a static string. This may be up to 200 characters.|
|metadata|object|true|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.|
|name|string \| null|false|none|Friendly display name.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|physical_bundle|string \| [issuing.physical_bundle](#schemaissuing.physical_bundle)|true|none|The physical bundle object belonging to this personalization design.|
|preferences|[issuing_personalization_design_preferences](#schemaissuing_personalization_design_preferences)|true|none|none|
|rejection_reasons|[issuing_personalization_design_rejection_reasons](#schemaissuing_personalization_design_rejection_reasons)|true|none|none|
|status|string|true|none|Whether this personalization design can be used to create cards.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|object|issuing.personalization_design|
|status|active|
|status|inactive|
|status|rejected|
|status|review|

When a non-stripe BIN is used, any use of an [issued card](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing) must be settled directly with the card network. The net amount owed is represented by an Issuing `Settlement` object.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|bin|string|true|none|The Bank Identification Number reflecting this settlement record.|
|clearing_date|integer(unix-time)|true|none|The date that the transactions are cleared and posted to user's accounts.|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|currency|string(currency)|true|none|Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|interchange_fees_amount|integer|true|none|The total interchange received as reimbursement for the transactions.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|metadata|object|true|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.|
|net_total_amount|integer|true|none|The total net amount required to settle with the network.|
|network|string|true|none|The card network for this settlement report. One of ["visa", "maestro", "mastercard"]|
|network_fees_amount|integer|true|none|The total amount of fees owed to the network.|
|network_settlement_identifier|string|true|none|The Settlement Identification Number assigned by the network.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|settlement_service|string|true|none|One of `international` or `uk_national_net`.|
|status|string|true|none|The current processing status of this settlement.|
|transaction_amount|integer|true|none|The total transaction amount reflected in this settlement.|
|transaction_count|integer|true|none|The total number of transactions reflected in this settlement.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|network|maestro|
|network|mastercard|
|network|visa|
|object|issuing.settlement|
|status|complete|
|status|pending|

An issuing token object is created when an issued card is added to a digital wallet. As a [card issuer](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing), you can [view and manage these tokens](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/controls/token-management) through Stripe.

|device_fingerprint|string \| null|false|none|The hashed ID derived from the device ID from the card network associated with the token.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|last4|string|false|none|The last four digits of the token.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|network|string|true|none|The token service provider / card network associated with the token.|
|network_data|[issuing_network_token_network_data](#schemaissuing_network_token_network_data)|false|none|none|
|network_updated_at|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the token was last updated by the card network. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|status|string|true|none|The usage state of the token.|
|wallet_provider|string|false|none|The digital wallet for this token, if one was used.|

Any use of an [issued card](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing) that results in funds entering or leaving
your Stripe account, such as a completed purchase or refund, is represented by an Issuing
`Transaction` object.

Related guide: [Issued card transactions](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/purchases/transactions)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer|true|none|The transaction amount, which will be reflected in your balance. This amount is in your currency and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|
|amount_details|[issuing_transaction_amount_details](#schemaissuing_transaction_amount_details) \| null|false|none|Detailed breakdown of amount components. These amounts are denominated in `currency` and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|
|authorization|string \| [issuing.authorization](#schemaissuing.authorization) \| null|false|none|The `Authorization` object that led to this transaction.|
|balance_transaction|string \| [balance_transaction](#schemabalance_transaction) \| null|false|none|ID of the [balance transaction](https://docs.stripe.com/api/balance_transactions) associated with this transaction.|
|card|string \| [issuing.card](#schemaissuing.card)|true|none|The card used to make this transaction.|
|cardholder|string \| [issuing.cardholder](#schemaissuing.cardholder) \| null|false|none|The cardholder to whom this transaction belongs.|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|currency|string(currency)|true|none|Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|dispute|string \| [issuing.dispute](#schemaissuing.dispute) \| null|false|none|If you've disputed the transaction, the ID of the dispute.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|merchant_amount|integer|true|none|The amount that the merchant will receive, denominated in `merchant_currency` and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal). It will be different from `amount` if the merchant is taking payment in a different currency.|
|merchant_currency|string(currency)|true|none|The currency with which the merchant is taking payment.|
|merchant_data|[issuing_authorization_merchant_data](#schemaissuing_authorization_merchant_data)|true|none|none|
|metadata|object|true|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.|
|network_data|[issuing_transaction_network_data](#schemaissuing_transaction_network_data) \| null|false|none|Details about the transaction, such as processing dates, set by the card network.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|purchase_details|[issuing_transaction_purchase_details](#schemaissuing_transaction_purchase_details) \| null|false|none|Additional purchase information that is optionally provided by the merchant.|
|token|string \| [issuing.token](#schemaissuing.token) \| null|false|none|[Token](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/tokens/object) object used for this transaction. If a network token was not used for this transaction, this field will be null.|
|treasury|[issuing_transaction_treasury](#schemaissuing_transaction_treasury) \| null|false|none|[Treasury](https://docs.stripe.com/api/treasury) details related to this transaction if it was created on a [FinancialAccount](/docs/api/treasury/financial_accounts|
|type|string|true|none|The nature of the transaction.|
|wallet|string \| null|false|none|The digital wallet used for this transaction. One of `apple_pay`, `google_pay`, or `samsung_pay`.|

|merchant_currency|string(currency)|true|none|The local currency the merchant is requesting to authorize.|
|network_risk_score|integer \| null|false|none|The card network's estimate of the likelihood that an authorization is fraudulent. Takes on values between 1 and 99.|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_authorization_request">issuing_authorization_request</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_authorization_request"></a>

```json
{
  "amount": 0,
  "amount_details": {
    "atm_fee": 0,
    "cashback_amount": 0
  },
  "approved": true,
  "authorization_code": "string",
  "created": 0,
  "currency": "string",
  "merchant_amount": 0,
  "merchant_currency": "string",
  "network_risk_score": 0,
  "reason": "account_disabled",
  "reason_message": "string",
  "requested_at": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer|true|none|The `pending_request.amount` at the time of the request, presented in your card's currency and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal). Stripe held this amount from your account to fund the authorization if the request was approved.|
|amount_details|[issuing_authorization_amount_details](#schemaissuing_authorization_amount_details) \| null|false|none|Detailed breakdown of amount components. These amounts are denominated in `currency` and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|
|approved|boolean|true|none|Whether this request was approved.|
|authorization_code|string \| null|false|none|A code created by Stripe which is shared with the merchant to validate the authorization. This field will be populated if the authorization message was approved. The code typically starts with the letter "S", followed by a six-digit number. For example, "S498162". Please note that the code is not guaranteed to be unique across authorizations.|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|currency|string|true|none|Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|merchant_amount|integer|true|none|The `pending_request.merchant_amount` at the time of the request, presented in the `merchant_currency` and in the [smallest currency unit](https://docs.stripe.com/currencies#zero-decimal).|
|merchant_currency|string|true|none|The currency that was collected by the merchant and presented to the cardholder for the authorization. Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|network_risk_score|integer \| null|false|none|The card network's estimate of the likelihood that an authorization is fraudulent. Takes on values between 1 and 99.|
|reason|string|true|none|When an authorization is approved or declined by you or by Stripe, this field provides additional detail on the reason for the outcome.|
|reason_message|string \| null|false|none|If the `request_history.reason` is `webhook_error` because the direct webhook response is invalid (for example, parsing errors or missing parameters), we surface a more detailed error message via this field.|
|requested_at|integer(unix-time) \| null|false|none|Time when the card network received an authorization request from the acquirer in UTC. Referred to by networks as transmission time.|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_card_authorization_controls">issuing_card_authorization_controls</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_card_authorization_controls"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_card_authorization_controls"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_card_authorization_controls"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_card_authorization_controls"></a>

```json
{
  "allowed_card_presences": [
    "not_present"
  ],
  "allowed_categories": [
    "ac_refrigeration_repair"
  ],
  "allowed_merchant_countries": [
    "string"
  ],
  "blocked_card_presences": [
    "not_present"
  ],
  "blocked_categories": [
    "ac_refrigeration_repair"
  ],
  "blocked_merchant_countries": [
    "string"
  ],
  "spending_limits": [
    {
      "amount": 0,
      "categories": [
        "ac_refrigeration_repair"
      ],
      "interval": "all_time"
    }
  ],
  "spending_limits_currency": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allowed_card_presences|[string]|false|none|Array of card presence statuses from which authorizations will be allowed. Possible options are `present`, `not_present`. All other statuses will be blocked. Cannot be set with `blocked_card_presences`. Provide an empty value to unset this control.|
|allowed_categories|[string]|false|none|Array of strings containing [categories](https://docs.stripe.com/api#issuing_authorization_object-merchant_data-category) of authorizations to allow. All other categories will be blocked. Cannot be set with `blocked_categories`.|
|allowed_merchant_countries|[string]|false|none|Array of strings containing representing countries from which authorizations will be allowed. Authorizations from merchants in all other countries will be declined. Country codes should be ISO 3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. `US`). Cannot be set with `blocked_merchant_countries`. Provide an empty value to unset this control.|
|blocked_card_presences|[string]|false|none|Array of card presence statuses from which authorizations will be declined. Possible options are `present`, `not_present`. Cannot be set with `allowed_card_presences`. Provide an empty value to unset this control.|
|blocked_categories|[string]|false|none|Array of strings containing [categories](https://docs.stripe.com/api#issuing_authorization_object-merchant_data-category) of authorizations to decline. All other categories will be allowed. Cannot be set with `allowed_categories`.|
|blocked_merchant_countries|[string]|false|none|Array of strings containing representing countries from which authorizations will be declined. Country codes should be ISO 3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. `US`). Cannot be set with `allowed_merchant_countries`. Provide an empty value to unset this control.|
|spending_limits|[[issuing_card_spending_limit](#schemaissuing_card_spending_limit)]|false|none|Limit spending with amount-based rules that apply across any cards this card replaced (i.e., its `replacement_for` card and _that_ card's `replacement_for` card, up the chain).|
|spending_limits_currency|string(currency) \| null|false|none|Currency of the amounts within `spending_limits`. Always the same as the currency of the card.|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_card_fraud_warning">issuing_card_fraud_warning</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_card_fraud_warning"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_card_fraud_warning"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_card_fraud_warning"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_card_fraud_warning"></a>

```json
{
  "started_at": 0,
  "type": "card_testing_exposure"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|started_at|integer(unix-time) \| null|false|none|Timestamp of the most recent fraud warning.|
|type|string \| null|false|none|The type of fraud warning that most recently took place on this card. This field updates with every new fraud warning, so the value changes over time. If populated, cancel and reissue the card.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|card_testing_exposure|
|type|fraud_dispute_filed|
|type|third_party_reported|
|type|user_indicated_fraud|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_card_shipping">issuing_card_shipping</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_card_shipping"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_card_shipping"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_card_shipping"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_card_shipping"></a>

```json
{
  "address": {
    "city": "string",
    "country": "string",
    "line1": "string",
    "line2": "string",
    "postal_code": "string",
    "state": "string"
  },
  "address_validation": {
    "mode": "disabled",
    "normalized_address": {
      "city": "string",
      "country": "string",
      "line1": "string",
      "line2": "string",
      "postal_code": "string",
      "state": "string"
    },
    "result": "indeterminate"
  },
  "business_name": "string",
  "carrier": "correos",
  "customs": {
    "eori_number": "string"
  },
  "eta": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "phone_number": "string",
  "require_signature": true,
  "service": "express",
  "status": "canceled",
  "tracking_number": "string",
  "tracking_url": "string",
  "type": "bulk"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address|[address](#schemaaddress)|true|none|none|
|address_validation|[issuing_card_shipping_address_validation](#schemaissuing_card_shipping_address_validation) \| null|false|none|Address validation details for the shipment.|
|business_name|string \| null|false|none|The name of the business at the shipping address, used on the shipping label to ensure delivery when the card is shipped to a cardholder's workplace.|
|carrier|string \| null|false|none|The delivery company that shipped a card.|
|customs|[issuing_card_shipping_customs](#schemaissuing_card_shipping_customs) \| null|false|none|Additional information that may be required for clearing customs.|
|eta|integer(unix-time) \| null|false|none|A unix timestamp representing a best estimate of when the card will be delivered.|
|name|string|true|none|Recipient name.|
|phone_number|string \| null|false|none|The phone number of the receiver of the shipment. Our courier partners will use this number to contact you in the event of card delivery issues. For individual shipments to the EU/UK, if this field is empty, we will provide them with the phone number provided when the cardholder was initially created.|
|require_signature|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether a signature is required for card delivery. This feature is only supported for US users. Standard shipping service does not support signature on delivery. The default value for standard shipping service is false and for express and priority services is true.|
|service|string|true|none|Shipment service, such as `standard` or `express`.|
|status|string \| null|false|none|The delivery status of the card.|
|tracking_number|string \| null|false|none|A tracking number for a card shipment.|
|tracking_url|string \| null|false|none|A link to the shipping carrier's site where you can view detailed information about a card shipment.|
|type|string|true|none|Packaging options.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|carrier|correos|
|carrier|dhl|
|carrier|fedex|
|carrier|royal_mail|
|carrier|usps|
|service|express|
|service|priority|
|service|standard|
|status|canceled|
|status|delivered|
|status|failure|
|status|pending|
|status|returned|
|status|shipped|
|status|submitted|
|type|bulk|
|type|individual|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_card_wallets">issuing_card_wallets</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_card_wallets"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_card_wallets"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_card_wallets"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_card_wallets"></a>

```json
{
  "apple_pay": {
    "eligible": true,
    "ineligible_reason": "missing_agreement"
  },
  "google_pay": {
    "eligible": true,
    "ineligible_reason": "missing_agreement"
  },
  "primary_account_identifier": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|apple_pay|[issuing_card_apple_pay](#schemaissuing_card_apple_pay)|true|none|none|
|google_pay|[issuing_card_google_pay](#schemaissuing_card_google_pay)|true|none|none|
|primary_account_identifier|string \| null|false|none|Unique identifier for a card used with digital wallets|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_cardholder_authorization_controls">issuing_cardholder_authorization_controls</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_cardholder_authorization_controls"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_cardholder_authorization_controls"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_cardholder_authorization_controls"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_cardholder_authorization_controls"></a>

```json
{
  "allowed_card_presences": [
    "not_present"
  ],
  "allowed_categories": [
    "ac_refrigeration_repair"
  ],
  "allowed_merchant_countries": [
    "string"
  ],
  "blocked_card_presences": [
    "not_present"
  ],
  "blocked_categories": [
    "ac_refrigeration_repair"
  ],
  "blocked_merchant_countries": [
    "string"
  ],
  "spending_limits": [
    {
      "amount": 0,
      "categories": [
        "ac_refrigeration_repair"
      ],
      "interval": "all_time"
    }
  ],
  "spending_limits_currency": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allowed_card_presences|[string]|false|none|Array of card presence statuses from which authorizations will be allowed. Possible options are `present`, `not_present`. All other statuses will be blocked. Cannot be set with `blocked_card_presences`. Provide an empty value to unset this control.|
|allowed_categories|[string]|false|none|Array of strings containing [categories](https://docs.stripe.com/api#issuing_authorization_object-merchant_data-category) of authorizations to allow. All other categories will be blocked. Cannot be set with `blocked_categories`.|
|allowed_merchant_countries|[string]|false|none|Array of strings containing representing countries from which authorizations will be allowed. Authorizations from merchants in all other countries will be declined. Country codes should be ISO 3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. `US`). Cannot be set with `blocked_merchant_countries`. Provide an empty value to unset this control.|
|blocked_card_presences|[string]|false|none|Array of card presence statuses from which authorizations will be declined. Possible options are `present`, `not_present`. Cannot be set with `allowed_card_presences`. Provide an empty value to unset this control.|
|blocked_categories|[string]|false|none|Array of strings containing [categories](https://docs.stripe.com/api#issuing_authorization_object-merchant_data-category) of authorizations to decline. All other categories will be allowed. Cannot be set with `allowed_categories`.|
|blocked_merchant_countries|[string]|false|none|Array of strings containing representing countries from which authorizations will be declined. Country codes should be ISO 3166 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. `US`). Cannot be set with `allowed_merchant_countries`. Provide an empty value to unset this control.|
|spending_limits|[[issuing_cardholder_spending_limit](#schemaissuing_cardholder_spending_limit)]|false|none|Limit spending with amount-based rules that apply across this cardholder's cards.|
|spending_limits_currency|string(currency) \| null|false|none|Currency of the amounts within `spending_limits`.|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_cardholder_card_issuing">issuing_cardholder_card_issuing</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_cardholder_card_issuing"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_cardholder_card_issuing"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_cardholder_card_issuing"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_cardholder_card_issuing"></a>

```json
{
  "user_terms_acceptance": {
    "date": 0,
    "ip": "string",
    "user_agent": "string"
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|user_terms_acceptance|[issuing_cardholder_user_terms_acceptance](#schemaissuing_cardholder_user_terms_acceptance) \| null|false|none|Information about cardholder acceptance of Celtic [Authorized User Terms](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/compliance-us#issuing-terms). Required for cards backed by a Celtic program.|

```json
{

}
```

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_cardholder_id_document">issuing_cardholder_id_document</h2>

<a id="tocsissuing_cardholder_id_document"></a>

```json
{
  "back": "string",
  "front": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|back|string \| [file](#schemafile) \| null|false|none|The back of a document returned by a [file upload](https://docs.stripe.com/api#create_file) with a `purpose` value of `identity_document`.|
|front|string \| [file](#schemafile) \| null|false|none|The front of a document returned by a [file upload](https://docs.stripe.com/api#create_file) with a `purpose` value of `identity_document`.|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_cardholder_individual">issuing_cardholder_individual</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_cardholder_individual"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_cardholder_individual"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_cardholder_individual"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_cardholder_individual"></a>

```json
{
  "card_issuing": {
    "user_terms_acceptance": {
      "date": 0,
      "ip": "string",
      "user_agent": "string"
    }
  },
  "dob": {
    "day": 0,
    "month": 0,
    "year": 0
  },
  "first_name": "string",
  "last_name": "string",
  "verification": {
    "document": {
      "back": "string",
      "front": "string"
    }
  }
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|card_issuing|[issuing_cardholder_card_issuing](#schemaissuing_cardholder_card_issuing) \| null|false|none|Information related to the card_issuing program for this cardholder.|
|dob|[issuing_cardholder_individual_dob](#schemaissuing_cardholder_individual_dob) \| null|false|none|The date of birth of this cardholder.|
|first_name|string \| null|false|none|The first name of this cardholder. Required before activating Cards. This field cannot contain any numbers, special characters (except periods, commas, hyphens, spaces and apostrophes) or non-latin letters.|
|last_name|string \| null|false|none|The last name of this cardholder. Required before activating Cards. This field cannot contain any numbers, special characters (except periods, commas, hyphens, spaces and apostrophes) or non-latin letters.|
|verification|[issuing_cardholder_verification](#schemaissuing_cardholder_verification) \| null|false|none|Government-issued ID document for this cardholder.|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_cardholder_user_terms_acceptance">issuing_cardholder_user_terms_acceptance</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_cardholder_user_terms_acceptance"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_cardholder_user_terms_acceptance"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_cardholder_user_terms_acceptance"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_cardholder_user_terms_acceptance"></a>

```json
{
  "date": 0,
  "ip": "string",
  "user_agent": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|date|integer(unix-time) \| null|false|none|The Unix timestamp marking when the cardholder accepted the Authorized User Terms.|
|ip|string \| null|false|none|The IP address from which the cardholder accepted the Authorized User Terms.|
|user_agent|string \| null|false|none|The user agent of the browser from which the cardholder accepted the Authorized User Terms.|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_dispute_canceled_evidence">issuing_dispute_canceled_evidence</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_dispute_canceled_evidence"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_dispute_canceled_evidence"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_dispute_canceled_evidence"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_dispute_canceled_evidence"></a>

```json
{
  "additional_documentation": "string",
  "canceled_at": 0,
  "cancellation_policy_provided": true,
  "cancellation_reason": "string",
  "expected_at": 0,
  "explanation": "string",
  "product_description": "string",
  "product_type": "merchandise",
  "return_status": "merchant_rejected",
  "returned_at": 0
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|additional_documentation|string \| [file](#schemafile) \| null|false|none|(ID of a [file upload](https://stripe.com/docs/guides/file-upload)) Additional documentation supporting the dispute.|
|canceled_at|integer(unix-time) \| null|false|none|Date when order was canceled.|
|cancellation_policy_provided|boolean \| null|false|none|Whether the cardholder was provided with a cancellation policy.|
|cancellation_reason|string \| null|false|none|Reason for canceling the order.|
|expected_at|integer(unix-time) \| null|false|none|Date when the cardholder expected to receive the product.|
|explanation|string \| null|false|none|Explanation of why the cardholder is disputing this transaction.|
|product_description|string \| null|false|none|Description of the merchandise or service that was purchased.|
|product_type|string \| null|false|none|Whether the product was a merchandise or service.|
|return_status|string \| null|false|none|Result of cardholder's attempt to return the product.|
|returned_at|integer(unix-time) \| null|false|none|Date when the product was returned or attempted to be returned.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|product_type|merchandise|
|product_type|service|
|return_status|merchant_rejected|
|return_status|successful|

<h2 id="tocS_issuing_dispute_duplicate_evidence">issuing_dispute_duplicate_evidence</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaissuing_dispute_duplicate_evidence"></a>
<a id="schema_issuing_dispute_duplicate_evidence"></a>
<a id="tocSissuing_dispute_duplicate_evidence"></a>
<a id="tocsissuing_dispute_duplicate_evidence"></a>

```json
{
  "additional_documentation": "string",
  "card_statement": "string",
  "cash_receipt": "string",
  "check_image": "string",
  "explanation": "string",
  "original_transaction": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|additional_documentation|string \| [file](#schemafile) \| null|false|none|(ID of a [file upload](https://stripe.com/docs/guides/file-upload)) Additional documentation supporting the dispute.|
|card_statement|string \| [file](#schemafile) \| null|false|none|(ID of a [file upload](https://stripe.com/docs/guides/file-upload)) Copy of the card statement showing that the product had already been paid for.|
|cash_receipt|string \| [file](#schemafile) \| null|false|none|(ID of a [file upload](https://stripe.com/docs/guides/file-upload)) Copy of the receipt showing that the product had been paid for in cash.|
|check_image|string \| [file](#schemafile) \| null|false|none|(ID of a [file upload](https://stripe.com/docs/guides/file-upload)) Image of the front and back of the check that was used to pay for the product.|
|explanation|string \| null|false|none|Explanation of why the cardholder is disputing this transaction.|
|original_transaction|string \| null|false|none|Transaction (e.g., ipi_...) that the disputed transaction is a duplicate of. Of the two or more transactions that are copies of each other, this is original undisputed one.|

Invoice Line Items represent the individual lines within an [invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices) and only exist within the context of an invoice.

Each line item is backed by either an [invoice item](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoiceitems) or a [subscription item](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscription_items).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer|true|none|The amount, in cents (or local equivalent).|
|currency|string(currency)|true|none|Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies).|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.|
|discount_amounts|[[discounts_resource_discount_amount](#schemadiscounts_resource_discount_amount)]|false|none|The amount of discount calculated per discount for this line item.|
|discountable|boolean|true|none|If true, discounts will apply to this line item. Always false for prorations.|
|discounts|[string \| [discount](#schemadiscount)]|true|none|The discounts applied to the invoice line item. Line item discounts are applied before invoice discounts. Use `expand[]=discounts` to expand each discount.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|invoice|string \| null|false|none|The ID of the invoice that contains this line item.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|metadata|object|true|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Note that for line items with `type=subscription`, `metadata` reflects the current metadata from the subscription associated with the line item, unless the invoice line was directly updated with different metadata after creation.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|parent|[billing_bill_resource_invoicing_lines_parents_invoice_line_item_parent](#schemabilling_bill_resource_invoicing_lines_parents_invoice_line_item_parent) \| null|false|none|The parent that generated this line item.|
|period|[invoice_line_item_period](#schemainvoice_line_item_period)|true|none|none|
|pretax_credit_amounts|[[invoices_resource_pretax_credit_amount](#schemainvoices_resource_pretax_credit_amount)]|false|none|Contains pretax credit amounts (ex: discount, credit grants, etc) that apply to this line item.|
|pricing|[billing_bill_resource_invoicing_pricing_pricing](#schemabilling_bill_resource_invoicing_pricing_pricing) \| null|false|none|The pricing information of the line item.|
|quantity|integer \| null|false|none|Quantity of units for the invoice line item in integer format, with any decimal precision truncated. For the line item's full-precision decimal quantity, use `quantity_decimal`. This field will be deprecated in favor of `quantity_decimal` in a future version. If the line item is a proration or subscription, the quantity of the subscription that the proration was computed for.|
|quantity_decimal|string(decimal) \| null|false|none|Non-negative decimal with at most 12 decimal places. The quantity of units for the line item.|
|subscription|string \| [subscription](#schemasubscription) \| null|false|none|none|
|subtotal|integer|true|none|The subtotal of the line item, in cents (or local equivalent), before any discounts or taxes.|
|taxes|[[billing_bill_resource_invoicing_taxes_tax](#schemabilling_bill_resource_invoicing_taxes_tax)]|false|none|The tax information of the line item.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|object|line_item|

<h2 id="tocS_login_link">login_link</h2>


Login Links are single-use URLs that takes an Express account to the login page for their Stripe dashboard.
A Login Link differs from an [Account Link](https://docs.stripe.com/api/account_links) in that it takes the user directly to their [Express dashboard for the specified account](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/integrate-express-dashboard#create-login-link)

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|url|string|true|none|The URL for the login link.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|object|login_link|

A Mandate is a record of the permission that your customer gives you to debit their payment method.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|customer_acceptance|[customer_acceptance](#schemacustomer_acceptance)|true|none|none|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|multi_use|[mandate_multi_use](#schemamandate_multi_use)|false|none|none|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|on_behalf_of|string|false|none|The account (if any) that the mandate is intended for.|
|payment_method|string \| [payment_method](#schemapayment_method)|true|none|ID of the payment method associated with this mandate.|
|payment_method_details|[mandate_payment_method_details](#schemamandate_payment_method_details)|true|none|none|
|single_use|[mandate_single_use](#schemamandate_single_use)|false|none|none|
|status|string|true|none|The mandate status indicates whether or not you can use it to initiate a payment.|
|type|string|true|none|The type of the mandate.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|object|mandate|
|status|active|
|status|inactive|
|status|pending|
|type|multi_use|

A Payment Attempt Record represents an individual attempt at making a payment, on or off Stripe.
Each payment attempt tries to collect a fixed amount of money from a fixed customer and payment
method. Payment Attempt Records are attached to Payment Records. Only one attempt per Payment Record
can have guaranteed funds.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount)|true|none|A representation of an amount of money, consisting of an amount and a currency.|
|amount_authorized|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount)|true|none|A representation of an amount of money, consisting of an amount and a currency.|
|amount_canceled|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount)|true|none|A representation of an amount of money, consisting of an amount and a currency.|
|amount_failed|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount)|true|none|A representation of an amount of money, consisting of an amount and a currency.|
|amount_guaranteed|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount)|true|none|A representation of an amount of money, consisting of an amount and a currency.|
|amount_refunded|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount)|true|none|A representation of an amount of money, consisting of an amount and a currency.|
|amount_requested|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_amount)|true|none|A representation of an amount of money, consisting of an amount and a currency.|
|application|string \| null|false|none|ID of the Connect application that created the PaymentAttemptRecord.|
|created|integer(unix-time)|true|none|Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.|
|customer_details|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_customer_details](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_customer_details) \| null|false|none|Customer information for this payment.|
|customer_presence|string \| null|false|none|Indicates whether the customer was present in your checkout flow during this payment.|
|description|string \| null|false|none|An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.|
|id|string|true|none|Unique identifier for the object.|
|livemode|boolean|true|none|If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.|
|metadata|object|true|none|Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.|
|object|string|true|none|String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.|
|payment_method_details|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_payment_method_details](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_payment_method_details) \| null|false|none|Information about the Payment Method debited for this payment.|
|payment_record|string \| null|false|none|ID of the Payment Record this Payment Attempt Record belongs to.|
|processor_details|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_processor_details](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_processor_details)|true|none|Processor information associated with this payment.|
|reported_by|string|true|none|Indicates who reported the payment.|
|shipping_details|[payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_shipping_details](#schemapayments_primitives_payment_records_resource_shipping_details) \| null|false|none|Shipping information for this payment.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|customer_presence|off_session|
|customer_presence|on_session|
|object|payment_attempt_record|
|reported_by|self|
|reported_by|stripe|

<a id="schemapayment_flows_private_payment_methods_paypal_amount_details_line_item_payment_method_options"></a>

<a id="tocspayment_flows_private_payment_methods_paypal_amount_details_line_item_payment_method_options"></a>

```json
{
  "category": "digital_goods",
  "description": "string",
  "sold_by": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|category|string|false|none|Type of the line item.|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the line item.|
|sold_by|string|false|none|The Stripe account ID of the connected account that sells the item. This is only needed when using [Separate Charges and Transfers](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/separate-charges-and-transfers).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|category|digital_goods|
|category|donation|
|category|physical_goods|

<h2 id="tocS_payment_flows_private_payment_methods_samsung_pay_payment_method_options">payment_flows_private_payment_methods_samsung_pay_payment_method_options</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapayment_flows_private_payment_methods_samsung_pay_payment_method_options"></a>
<a id="schema_payment_flows_private_payment_methods_samsung_pay_payment_method_options"></a>
<a id="tocSpayment_flows_private_payment_methods_samsung_pay_payment_method_options"></a>
<a id="tocspayment_flows_private_payment_methods_samsung_pay_payment_method_options"></a>

```json
{
  "capture_method": "manual",
  "setup_future_usage": "none"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|capture_method|string|false|none|Controls when the funds will be captured from the customer's account.|
|setup_future_usage|string|false|none|Indicates that you intend to make future payments with this PaymentIntent's payment method.<br><br>If you provide a Customer with the PaymentIntent, you can use this parameter to [attach the payment method](/payments/save-during-payment) to the Customer after the PaymentIntent is confirmed and the customer completes any required actions. If you don't provide a Customer, you can still [attach](/api/payment_methods/attach) the payment method to a Customer after the transaction completes.<br><br>If the payment method is `card_present` and isn't a digital wallet, Stripe creates and attaches a [generated_card](/api/charges/object#charge_object-payment_method_details-card_present-generated_card) payment method representing the card to the Customer instead.<br><br>When processing card payments, Stripe uses `setup_future_usage` to help you comply with regional legislation and network rules, such as [SCA](/strong-customer-authentication).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|capture_method|manual|
|setup_future_usage|none|
